entry: It sheds its skin and gradually grows larger. Its scales can be ground into a powder and used as raw materials for traditional medicine.

name: Gabite
entry: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Gabite
entry: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

name: Gabite
entry: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.

name: Gabite
entry: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

name: Gabite
entry: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

name: Gabite
entry: Jewels are buried in the caves these Pokémon nest in, but you'll be torn apart by claws and fangs the moment you enter one of these caves.

name: Gabite
entry: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal incurable illnesses.

name: Gabite
entry: As it digs to expand its nest, it unearths raw gemstones. It has a habit of hoarding these in its nest.

name: Garchomp
entry: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

name: Garchomp
entry: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

name: Garchomp
entry: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

name: Garchomp
entry: Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

name: Garchomp
entry: Its disposition is more vicious than before its Mega Evolution. Garchomp carves its opponents up with the scythes on both arms.

name: Garchomp
entry: It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes. It dives into flocks of bird Pokémon and gulps the entire flock down whole.

name: Garchomp
entry: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

name: Garchomp
entry: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

name: Garchomp
entry: Its fine scales don't just reduce wind resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury to any opponent who attacks it.

name: Garchomp
entry: Excess energy melted its arms and wings, transforming them into giant scythes.

name: Garchomp
entry: Its vaunted wings become scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.

name: Garchomp
entry: Its arms and wings melted into something like scythes. Mad with rage, it rampages on and on.

name: Garchomp
entry: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

name: Garchomp
entry: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

name: Garchomp
entry: Garchomp is fast both underground and above. It can bring down prey and return to its den before its body has chilled from being outside.

name: Munchlax
entry: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

name: Munchlax
entry: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

name: Munchlax
entry: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Munchlax
entry: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.

name: Munchlax
entry: Anything that looks edible, Munchlax will go on and swallow whole. Its stomach is tough enough to handle it even if the food has gone rotten.

name: Munchlax
entry: It needs to consume its own weight in food every day. As far as flavor is concerned, it's indifferent.

name: Munchlax
entry: When it finds something that looks like it might be edible, it goes right ahead and swallows it whole. That's why it gets fatter day by day.

name: Munchlax
entry: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.

name: Munchlax
entry: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

name: Munchlax
entry: Stuffing itself with vast amounts of food is its only concern. Whether the food is rotten or fresh, yummy or tasteless—it does not care.

name: Munchlax
entry: It stores food beneath its fur. It might share just one bite, but only if it really trusts you.

name: Munchlax
entry: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing it whole with almost no chewing.

name: Munchlax
entry: When it is voraciously gulping down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Riolu
entry: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Riolu
entry: Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.

name: Riolu
entry: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Riolu
entry: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Riolu
entry: It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.

name: Riolu
entry: It uses waves called auras to communicate with others of its kind. It doesn't make any noise during this time, so its enemies can't detect it.

name: Riolu
entry: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

name: Riolu
entry: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

name: Riolu
entry: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

name: Riolu
entry: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

name: Riolu
entry: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Riolu
entry: It can use waves called auras to gauge how others are feeling. These same waves can also tell this Pokémon about the state of the environment.

name: Riolu
entry: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions, such as joy and rage, in the form of waves.

name: Lucario
entry: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

name: Lucario
entry: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

name: Lucario
entry: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Lucario
entry: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario , since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Lucario
entry: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Lucario
entry: Bathed in explosive energy, its combative instincts have awakened. For its enemies, it has no mercy whatsoever.

name: Lucario
entry: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

name: Lucario
entry: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

name: Lucario
entry: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

name: Lucario
entry: Lucario reads its opponent's feelings with its aura waves. It finds out things it would rather not know, so it gets stressed out easily.

name: Lucario
entry: Black streaks all over its body show where its auras and the energy of Mega Evolution intermingled and raced through it.

name: Lucario
entry: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

name: Lucario
entry: Its aura has expanded due to Mega Evolution. Governed only by its combative instincts, it strikes enemies without mercy.

name: Lucario
entry: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name “aura” to this power.

name: Lucario
entry: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

name: Lucario
entry: It can tell what people are thinking. Only Trainers who have justice in their hearts can earn this Pokémon's trust.

name: Lucario
entry: By sensing the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

name: Lucario
entry: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Lucario
entry: A well-trained one can use its aura to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Hippopotas
entry: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

name: Hippopotas
entry: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

name: Hippopotas
entry: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

name: Hippopotas
entry: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

name: Hippopotas
entry: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hippopotas
entry: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

name: Hippopotas
entry: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snuggly into the sand.

name: Hippopotas
entry: It shuts its nostrils tight, then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.

name: Hippowdon
entry: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

name: Hippowdon
entry: Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across. It has enough power to completely crush a car.

name: Hippowdon
entry: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

name: Hippowdon
entry: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

name: Hippowdon
entry: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

name: Hippowdon
entry: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

name: Hippowdon
entry: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.

name: Hippowdon
entry: Its huge mouth opens almost seven feet wide. It has enough power to completely crush a car.

name: Skorupi
entry: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Skorupi
entry: It lives in arid lands. It buries itself in sand and lies in wait for unsuspecting prey.

name: Skorupi
entry: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

name: Skorupi
entry: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

name: Skorupi
entry: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

name: Skorupi
entry: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

name: Skorupi
entry: It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this Pokémon's poison seeps in.

name: Drapion
entry: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

name: Drapion
entry: Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.

name: Drapion
entry: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.

name: Drapion
entry: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

name: Drapion
entry: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

name: Drapion
entry: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

name: Drapion
entry: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

name: Drapion
entry: It's so vicious that it's called the Sand Demon. Yet when confronted by Hippowdon , Drapion keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

name: Croagunk
entry: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

name: Croagunk
entry: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

name: Croagunk
entry: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

name: Croagunk
entry: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower-back HG /lower back SS pain.

name: Croagunk
entry: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Croagunk
entry: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

name: Croagunk
entry: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

name: Croagunk
entry: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

name: Croagunk
entry: It inflates its poison sacs and makes a blubbering sound to intimidate foes.

name: Toxicroak
entry: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Toxicroak
entry: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

name: Toxicroak
entry: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

name: Toxicroak
entry: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

name: Toxicroak
entry: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

name: Toxicroak
entry: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

name: Toxicroak
entry: It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.

name: Toxicroak
entry: The toxin made in its poison sac is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

name: Carnivine
entry: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Carnivine
entry: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.

name: Carnivine
entry: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Carnivine
entry: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

name: Carnivine
entry: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

name: Carnivine
entry: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat its prey.

name: Carnivine
entry: Using its tentacles to hang from branches, it looks like a plant when it is not moving. It awaits prey with its mouth wide open.

name: Finneon
entry: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

name: Finneon
entry: The way its two tail fins flutter while it swims has earned it the nickname " Beautifly of the Sea."

name: Finneon
entry: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Finneon
entry: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a Beautifly . At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.

name: Finneon
entry: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

name: Finneon
entry: It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin, which then shine. This appears to be a form of camouflage.

name: Finneon
entry: Its double tail fins propel its energetic jumps. When it breaks the surface of the sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on the fly.

name: Finneon
entry: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

name: Finneon
entry: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: "finery fish."

name: Finneon
entry: The way its two tail fins flutter while it swims has earned it the nickname Beautifly of the Sea.

name: Lumineon
entry: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

name: Lumineon
entry: To avoid detection by predators, it crawls along the seafloor using the two fins on its chest.

name: Lumineon
entry: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn .

name: Lumineon
entry: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

name: Lumineon
entry: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

name: Lumineon
entry: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.

name: Lumineon
entry: This deep-sea Pokémon lives at the bottom of the sea. Its fins haul it over the seabed in search of its favorite food— Starmie .

name: Lumineon
entry: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

name: Lumineon
entry: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking—it's as though there were shining stars right there.

name: Lumineon
entry: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing patterns on its four fins.

name: Mantyke
entry: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

name: Mantyke
entry: Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.

name: Mantyke
entry: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with Remoraid .

name: Mantyke
entry: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.

name: Mantyke
entry: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

name: Mantyke
entry: Mantyke are friendly toward people and will approach boats closely. The patterns on their backs differ depending on their habitat.

name: Mantyke
entry: It's highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.

name: Mantyke
entry: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

name: Mantyke
entry: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.

name: Mantyke
entry: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they'll all fight together to repel attackers.

name: Mantyke
entry: A friendly Pokémon that senses the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

name: Snover
entry: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

name: Snover
entry: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

name: Snover
entry: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Snover
entry: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

name: Snover
entry: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

name: Snover
entry: The berries that grow around its belly are like ice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely love these berries.

name: Snover
entry: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Abomasnow
entry: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

name: Abomasnow
entry: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

name: Abomasnow
entry: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

name: Abomasnow
entry: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Abomasnow
entry: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

name: Abomasnow
entry: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

name: Abomasnow
entry: This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

name: Abomasnow
entry: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as the Ice Monster.

name: Abomasnow
entry: The buds on its back have sprouted into impressive icicles that can whip up massive blizzards of −22 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Weavile
entry: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Weavile
entry: It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost-covered trees and ice.

name: Weavile
entry: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

name: Weavile
entry: Thanks to its increased intelligence, scrapping over food is a thing of the past. A scratch from its claws will give you a case of frostbite!

name: Weavile
entry: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Weavile
entry: They dwell in cold places. This Pokémon's main food source in Alola is Vulpix and Sandshrew , which they carefully divide among their group.

name: Weavile

name: Weavile
entry: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

name: Weavile
entry: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

name: Weavile
entry: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.

name: Weavile
entry: It sends signals to others of its kind by carving odd patterns on trees and ice.

name: Magnezone

name: Magnezone
entry: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

name: Magnezone

name: Magnezone

entry: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Lickilicky

name: Lickilicky
entry: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

name: Lickilicky
entry: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

name: Lickilicky

name: Lickilicky

name: Lickilicky

name: Lickilicky

name: Lickilicky

name: Lickilicky

name: Rhyperior
entry: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

name: Rhyperior
entry: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

name: Rhyperior
entry: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude . Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Rhyperior
entry: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Rhyperior
entry: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

name: Rhyperior

name: Rhyperior
entry: It relies on its carapace to deflect incoming attacks and throw its enemy off balance. As soon as that happens, it drives its drill into the foe.

name: Rhyperior
entry: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. On rare occasions, the Pokémon even shoots out Geodude.

name: Rhyperior
entry: A Rhyperior's brain is smaller than a Rhydon's, but the Rhyperior is stronger because it spends more energy on battling and less on brainpower.

name: Rhyperior
entry: This Pokémon's sturdy carapace protects it from volcanic eruptions. It shoots round rocks from the holes in its hands.

name: Tangrowth
entry: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Tangrowth
entry: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

name: Tangrowth

entry: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

name: Giratina
entry: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

name: Cresselia
entry: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Cresselia
entry: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

name: Cresselia
entry: Those who sleep holding Cresselia 's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Cresselia
entry: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Cresselia
entry: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

name: Cresselia
entry: When it flies, it releases shiny particles from its veil-like wings. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Phione
entry: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

name: Phione
entry: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Phione
entry: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

name: Phione
entry: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

name: Manaphy
entry: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

name: Manaphy
entry: Water makes up 80% of its body. This Pokémon is easily affected by its environment.

name: Manaphy
entry: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Manaphy
entry: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Manaphy
entry: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione , it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

name: Manaphy
entry: Water makes up 80 percent of its body. This Pokémon is easily affected by its environment.

name: Darkrai
entry: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Darkrai
entry: Folklore has it that on moonless nights, this Pokémon will make people see horrific nightmares.

name: Darkrai
entry: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

name: Darkrai
entry: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Darkrai
entry: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

name: Darkrai
entry: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of a new moon.

name: Shaymin
entry: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

name: Shaymin
entry: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Shaymin
entry: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Shaymin
entry: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Shaymin
entry: Upon taking in the scent of a particular rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light, and its tiny body transforms. I took a whiff of the flower myself, but alas, my body remained unchanged.

name: Shaymin
entry: It lives in common flower patches but is rarely noticed. It is often mistaken for a flowering plant when curled up.

name: Shaymin
entry: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

name: Arceus
entry: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

name: Arceus
entry: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

name: Arceus
entry: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

name: Arceus
entry: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

name: Arceus
entry: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

name: Arceus
entry: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was the first Pokémon born before the universe even existed.

name: Snivy
entry: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Snivy
entry: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

name: Snivy
entry: It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life, it dexterously controls its vines to compensate for its short arms.

name: Snivy
entry: The leaf on Snivy’s tail generates energy when exposed to sunlight, making Snivy swifter and adding an edge to its moves.

name: Servine
entry: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Servine
entry: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Servine
entry: Servine’s one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.

name: Servine
entry: It runs low to the ground, weaving through the grass, then mercilessly pummels its target by whipping them with its vines.

name: Serperior
entry: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Serperior
entry: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.

name: Serperior
entry: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.

name: Serperior
entry: It generates energy from sunlight, then amplifies that energy dozens of times within its long body.

name: Tepig
entry: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Tepig
entry: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Tepig
entry: It’s more nimble than it looks, and it uses its speed to confound its enemies. It rapidly launches fireballs from both nostrils.

name: Tepig
entry: This Pokémon is a ravenous glutton. It uses its excellent sense of smell to find food, then cooks it to a crisp before eating.

name: Pignite
entry: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Pignite
entry: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

name: Pignite
entry: When Pignite enters battle, its body temperature rapidly soars until Pignite itself is engulfed by a scorching fireball.

name: Pignite
entry: When defending its friends, Pignite will stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong. But it’s powerless when faced with an empty stomach.

name: Emboar
entry: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Emboar
entry: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Emboar
entry: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.

name: Emboar
entry: The flames blazing deep inside Emboar’s chest erupt vigorously from its chin, forming a beard of fire.

name: Emboar
entry: The direr the situation, the more it seems to enjoy itself. The flames around its neck intensify, too, increasing Emboar’s power and speed.

name: Oshawott
entry: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Oshawott
entry: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle—it can be used to break open hard berries as well.

name: Oshawott
entry: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop."

name: Oshawott
entry: It’s said that Oshawott learned to maintain its scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking humans it saw using whetstones.

name: Oshawott
entry: It wields the scalchop on its stomach like a knife, blocking the moves of its enemies before slashing back at them in swift retaliation.

name: Dewott
entry: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

name: Dewott
entry: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Dewott
entry: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Dewott
entry: Dewott has a studious and stern personality. It masters the use of its scalchops through dedicated, repeated training.

name: Dewott
entry: It’s said that people modeled swordplay after the way Dewott’s movements flow like water while it’s wielding its two scalchops.

name: Samurott
entry: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Samurott
entry: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

name: Samurott
entry: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui . Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Samurott
entry: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

name: Samurott
entry: A master of a sword-drawing art called iaijutsu, Samurott settles its battles with a single swing of either large sword sheathed in its foreleg armor.

name: Patrat
entry: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Patrat
entry: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
entry: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Watchog
entry: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Watchog
entry: Using luminescent matter within its body, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Lillipup
entry: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

name: Lillipup
entry: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

name: Lillipup
entry: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.

name: Lillipup
entry: Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

name: Lillipup
entry: The long fur surrounding its face functions as radar, enabling it to probe the condition of its battle opponents.

name: Lillipup
entry: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can't defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.

name: Lillipup
entry: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won't forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Lillipup
entry: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

name: Herdier
entry: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

name: Herdier
entry: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

name: Herdier
entry: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

name: Herdier
entry: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

name: Herdier
entry: This Pokémon obeys its master's orders faithfully. However, it refuses to listen to anything said by a person it doesn't respect.

name: Herdier
entry: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.

name: Herdier
entry: The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Herdier
entry: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

name: Stoutland
entry: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

name: Stoutland
entry: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

name: Stoutland
entry: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

name: Stoutland
entry: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it's a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

name: Stoutland
entry: With this wise Pokémon, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

name: Stoutland
entry: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

name: Stoutland
entry: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It's said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Stoutland
entry: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

name: Purrloin
entry: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Purrloin
entry: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Purrloin
entry: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Purrloin
entry: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
entry: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

name: Liepard
entry: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Liepard
entry: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

name: Liepard
entry: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Pansage
entry: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Pansage
entry: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Pansage
entry: It shares the leaves on its head with weary Pokémon. These leaves reduce fatigue.

name: Simisage
entry: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Simisage
entry: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

name: Simisage
entry: Ill-tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaves growing on its head are very bitter.

name: Pansear
entry: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Pansear
entry: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

name: Simisear
entry: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Simisear
entry: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Panpour
entry: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Panpour
entry: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

name: Panpour
entry: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It provides this water to plants by using its tail.

name: Simipour
entry: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Simipour
entry: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Simipour
entry: It prefers places with clean water. When the stores of water on its head run low, it replenishes its supply by siphoning up more with its tail.

name: Munna
entry: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Munna
entry: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Munna
entry: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

name: Munna
entry: Late at night, it appears beside people's pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

name: Musharna
entry: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Musharna
entry: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Musharna
entry: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Musharna
entry: When dark mists emanate from its body, don't get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

name: Pidove
entry: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Pidove
entry: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

name: Pidove
entry: It's forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Pidove
entry: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

name: Tranquill
entry: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

name: Tranquill
entry: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

name: Tranquill
entry: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Tranquill
entry: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

name: Unfezant
entry: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

name: Unfezant
entry: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

name: Unfezant
entry: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Unfezant
entry: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

name: Unfezant
entry: Females of this species are very capable fliers, particularly notable for their stamina. They also take longer to adjust to people.

name: Blitzle
entry: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Blitzle
entry: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Blitzle
entry: This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and stores the electricity within its body.

name: Blitzle
entry: Its heartbeat generates electricity. When Blitzle is surprised and its heart rate goes up, the voltage of its electricity also rises.

name: Zebstrika
entry: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Zebstrika
entry: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Zebstrika
entry: Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can use the lightning to charge up.

name: Zebstrika
entry: This Pokémon is aggressive and has a volatile disposition. When agitated, it will illuminate its mane in yellow and fire off bolts of electricity.

name: Roggenrola
entry: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

name: Roggenrola
entry: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Roggenrola
entry: It was found in a fissure in a layer of exposed rock. The material that makes up its body is dirt from several hundred years ago.

name: Roggenrola
entry: Born deep within the ground, it compares itself with similar species, such as Geodude and Carbink , to settle which has the hardest body.

name: Roggenrola
entry: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

name: Roggenrola
entry: The hexagonal hole is its ear. Deep in that ear is an energy core, so if you stick your hand in there, Roggenrola will be very angry!

name: Roggenrola
entry: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Roggenrola
entry: It's as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.

name: Boldore
entry: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.

name: Boldore
entry: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Boldore
entry: Its orange crystals are lumps of powerful energy. They're valuable, so Boldore is sometimes targeted for them.

name: Boldore
entry: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.

name: Boldore
entry: It explores caves in search of underground water. It's not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.

name: Boldore
entry: The energy overflowing from its body has turned into orange crystals that are hard enough to smash diamonds.

name: Boldore
entry: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.

name: Boldore
entry: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It's about to fire off bursts of energy.

name: Gigalith
entry: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

name: Gigalith
entry: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

name: Gigalith
entry: It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out energy. It's usually lurking deep beneath the surface.

name: Gigalith
entry: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it's not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

name: Gigalith
entry: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

name: Gigalith
entry: When it fires off energy with all its might, the power creates countless fissures on its body.

name: Gigalith
entry: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation—they can only be fired when the sun is out.

name: Gigalith
entry: This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah .

name: Woobat
entry: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

name: Woobat
entry: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Woobat
entry: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Woobat
entry: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
entry: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

name: Swoobat
entry: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

name: Swoobat
entry: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Swoobat
entry: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

name: Drilbur
entry: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Drilbur
entry: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Drilbur
entry: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Drilbur
entry: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Drilbur
entry: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Excadrill
entry: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

name: Excadrill
entry: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Excadrill
entry: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph .

name: Excadrill
entry: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

name: Excadrill
entry: If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.

name: Excadrill
entry: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick it is.

name: Excadrill
entry: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

name: Audino
entry: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Audino
entry: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Audino
entry: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.

name: Audino
entry: Audino's sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino's ears.

name: Audino
entry: Anyone who touches the secondary feelers that have sprouted from the base of its throat will fall into a deep sleep.

name: Audino
entry: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to check their emotions and physical health.

name: Timburr
entry: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

name: Timburr
entry: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

name: Timburr
entry: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

name: Timburr
entry: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

name: Timburr
entry: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
entry: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Gurdurr
entry: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

name: Gurdurr
entry: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Gurdurr
entry: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

name: Gurdurr
entry: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

name: Conkeldurr
entry: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

name: Conkeldurr
entry: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Conkeldurr
entry: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Conkeldurr
entry: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

name: Conkeldurr
entry: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.

name: Tympole
entry: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Tympole
entry: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

name: Tympole
entry: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

name: Tympole
entry: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

name: Palpitoad
entry: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

name: Palpitoad
entry: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Palpitoad
entry: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Palpitoad
entry: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

name: Seismitoad
entry: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

name: Seismitoad
entry: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Seismitoad
entry: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Seismitoad
entry: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

name: Throh
entry: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

name: Throh
entry: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Throh
entry: They train in groups of five. Any member that can't keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

name: Throh
entry: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.

name: Sawk
entry: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Sawk
entry: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

name: Sawk
entry: The karate chops of a Sawk that's trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

name: Sawk
entry: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.

name: Sewaddle
entry: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Sewaddle
entry: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Sewaddle
entry: The bumps on their heads are sensory organs. When Sewaddle meet, they greet each other by rubbing these bumps together.

name: Sewaddle
entry: Sewaddle chews on leaves to make its clothing. It's trying to mimic the leafy garment Leavanny first dressed it in.

name: Swadloon
entry: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Swadloon
entry: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Swadloon
entry: Swadloon wraps itself in leaves for protection. It uses the two leaves atop its head to detect air movements and feel out its surroundings.

name: Swadloon
entry: Swadloon lives quietly at the feet of trees. It prefers eating fallen leaves that have grown soft rather than fresh ones.

name: Leavanny
entry: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Leavanny
entry: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Leavanny
entry: It fashions clothing from woven leaves. Though gentle in disposition, it will show no mercy to foes who target young Pokémon.

name: Leavanny
entry: This gentle Pokémon has strong protective instincts. The leaves on its arms are sharp enough to slice a thick tree in half with one stroke.

name: Venipede
entry: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

name: Venipede
entry: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Venipede
entry: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

name: Venipede
entry: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

name: Venipede
entry: Its bite injects a venom potent enough to paralyze even the large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

name: Whirlipede
entry: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

name: Whirlipede
entry: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

name: Whirlipede
entry: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it'll need for evolution.

name: Whirlipede
entry: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph .

name: Scolipede
entry: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Scolipede
entry: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

name: Scolipede
entry: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch . At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

name: Scolipede
entry: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claw's toxic spikes.

name: Scolipede
entry: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.

name: Scolipede
entry: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until they stop moving. Then it finishes them off with deadly venom.

name: Cottonee
entry: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

name: Cottonee
entry: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

name: Cottonee
entry: When attacked, it expels cotton from its body to create a diversion. The cotton it loses grows back in quickly.

name: Cottonee
entry: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

name: Cottonee
entry: Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy—altogether top quality.

name: Cottonee
entry: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

name: Cottonee
entry: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.

name: Cottonee
entry: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Cottonee
entry: Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy— altogether top quality.

name: Whimsicott
entry: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

name: Whimsicott
entry: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

name: Whimsicott
entry: Whimsicott doesn't live in a fixed location. It floats around on whirling winds, appearing all over the place to perform its mischief.

name: Whimsicott
entry: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

name: Whimsicott
entry: This Pokémon appears, riding upon the wind. But if the wind gusts up, it'll blow the cotton on this Pokémon's head clean off.

name: Whimsicott
entry: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

name: Whimsicott
entry: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

name: Whimsicott
entry: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

name: Whimsicott
entry: It rides on the wind and slips into people’s homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton- filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

name: Petilil
entry: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

name: Petilil
entry: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

name: Petilil
entry: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.

name: Petilil
entry: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.

name: Petilil
entry: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

name: Petilil
entry: Some say if you dry the leaves on its head, boil them down, and drink the infusion, your vigor will return, so Petilil is popular with the elderly.

name: Petilil
entry: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Petilil
entry: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon's head results in a liquid that's sometimes used as a bug repellent.

name: Petilil
entry: The deeper the color of a Petilil's leaves, the healthier the Pokémon is. Petilil sometimes make its home in a well-tended field or flowerbed.

name: Petilil
entry: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

name: Petilil
entry: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

name: Lilligant
entry: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

name: Lilligant
entry: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

name: Lilligant
entry: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

name: Lilligant
entry: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

name: Lilligant
entry: As soon as it finds a male to be its partner, the beautiful flower on its head darkens, droops, and withers away.

name: Lilligant
entry: The fragrance of its flower differs slightly depending on the soil where it grew up. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.

name: Lilligant
entry: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Lilligant
entry: It's believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant's head to bloom.

name: Lilligant
entry: Essential oils made from Lilligant flowers have a sublime scent, but they're also staggeringly expensive.

name: Lilligant
entry: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Basculin
entry: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

name: Basculin
entry: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.

name: Basculin
entry: Some people call it “the thug of the lake.” Whether the differences in color are meaningful is not yet known.

name: Basculin
entry: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

name: Basculin
entry: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt . That's how violent Basculin are.

name: Basculin
entry: Even Basculin, which devours everything it can with its huge jaws, is nothing more than food to organisms stronger than itself.

name: Basculin
entry: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Basculin
entry: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.

name: Basculin
entry: In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it's more popular with the youth.

name: Basculin
entry: Blue-striped Basculin used to be a common food source. They apparently have an inoffensive, light flavor.

name: Basculin
entry: Known for their violence, these Pokémon have the most fights with schools of red-striped Basculin.

name: Basculin
entry: Its ecology is starkly different from that of other Basculin, so theories that it's a totally different species have gained traction in recent years.

name: Basculin
entry: Its temperament is vicious and aggressive. This Pokémon is also full of vitality and can multiply rapidly before anyone notices.

name: Basculin
entry: It's so vicious that it's called the Thug of the River. Yet Basculin is still targeted by predators, such as Dondozo and Bombirdier .

name: Basculin
entry: These Pokémon form schools with others of the same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue Basculin is a school of red Basculin.

name: Basculin
entry: The power of its jaws is immense—enough to leave teeth marks in iron sheets. Its personality is also extremely vicious.

name: Basculin
entry: They live in frigid seas, forming schools and sharing food among themselves. When the time comes, they return to the river they were born in.

name: Basculin
entry: Blue-Striped Basculin in the Alola Pokédex US UM

name: Basculin
entry: White-Striped Basculin in the Kitakami Pokédex

name: Sandile
entry: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

name: Sandile
entry: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Sandile
entry: Sandile's still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It's called “the cleaner of the desert.”

name: Sandile
entry: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Sandile
entry: It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.

name: Sandile
entry: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

name: Sandile
entry: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it's swimming.

name: Sandile
entry: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

name: Sandile
entry: It moves below the sand's surface, exposing only its nose and eyes. A black membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Sandile
entry: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
entry: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.

name: Krokorok
entry: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Krokorok
entry: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

name: Krokorok
entry: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.

name: Krokorok
entry: Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the middle of the night.

name: Krokorok
entry: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.

name: Krokorok
entry: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won't move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

name: Krokorok
entry: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

name: Krokorok
entry: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
entry: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Krookodile
entry: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

name: Krookodile
entry: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.

name: Krookodile
entry: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

name: Krookodile
entry: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Krookodile
entry: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles , it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

name: Krookodile
entry: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

name: Krookodile
entry: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

name: Krookodile
entry: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can tear apart the body of an automobile.

name: Darumaka
entry: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Darumaka
entry: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Darumaka
entry: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

name: Darumaka
entry: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

name: Darumaka
entry: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darumaka
entry: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

name: Darmanitan
entry: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit , making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: Darmanitan
entry: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

name: Darmanitan
entry: Darmanitan takes this form when enraged. It won't stop spewing flames until its rage has settled, even if its body starts to melt.

name: Darmanitan
entry: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Darmanitan
entry: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Darmanitan
entry: Through meditation, it calms its raging spirit and hones its psychic powers.

name: Darmanitan
entry: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

name: Darmanitan
entry: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

name: Darmanitan
entry: Though it has a gentle disposition, it's also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.

name: Darmanitan
entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

name: Maractus
entry: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Maractus
entry: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Maractus
entry: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Maractus
entry: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

name: Dwebble
entry: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

name: Dwebble
entry: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

name: Dwebble
