entry: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon .

name: Dwebble
entry: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly .

name: Crustle
entry: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

name: Crustle
entry: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

name: Crustle
entry: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior 's carapace.

name: Crustle
entry: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won't come out of its boulder on rainy days.

name: Scraggy
entry: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.

name: Scraggy
entry: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scraggy
entry: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. The saggier their skin, the more respect they garner.

name: Scraggy
entry: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

name: Scraggy
entry: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scraggy
entry: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

name: Scraggy
entry: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. Among Scraggy, individuals with saggier skin apparently garner more respect.

name: Scraggy
entry: It will abruptly headbutt anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is extremely hard.

name: Scrafty
entry: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

name: Scrafty
entry: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Scrafty
entry: It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a certain territory that it never leaves its whole life long.

name: Scrafty
entry: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Scrafty
entry: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Scrafty
entry: As halfhearted as this Pokémon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.

name: Scrafty
entry: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.

name: Scrafty
entry: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

name: Scrafty
entry: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more arrogantly it behaves.

name: Sigilyph
entry: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

name: Sigilyph
entry: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

name: Sigilyph
entry: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

name: Sigilyph
entry: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

name: Yamask
entry: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Yamask
entry: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Yamask
entry: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.

name: Yamask
entry: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that's said to have been the face it had when it was still human.

name: Yamask
entry: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Yamask
entry: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

name: Cofagrigus
entry: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

name: Cofagrigus
entry: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Cofagrigus
entry: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They're symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Cofagrigus
entry: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

name: Tirtouga
entry: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Tirtouga
entry: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.

name: Tirtouga
entry: Its hunting grounds encompassed a broad area, from the land to more than half a mile deep in the ocean.

name: Tirtouga
entry: Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to ocean depths of over half a mile.

name: Tirtouga
entry: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas approximately a hundred million years ago.

name: Tirtouga
entry: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

name: Tirtouga
entry: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

name: Tirtouga
entry: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.

name: Carracosta
entry: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

name: Carracosta
entry: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

name: Carracosta
entry: Carracosta eats every last bit of the prey it catches, even the shells and bones, to further strengthen its sturdy shell.

name: Carracosta
entry: It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.

name: Carracosta
entry: Active both on land and in the sea, this Pokémon drags its land-based prey into the water to finish it off.

name: Carracosta
entry: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.

name: Carracosta
entry: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

name: Carracosta
entry: Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones, shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta's own shell grows thick and sturdy.

name: Archen
entry: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

name: Archen
entry: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

name: Archen
entry: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can't yet fly.

name: Archen
entry: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

name: Archen
entry: To all appearances flightless, it was able to glide down from tall treetops to snag its prey.

name: Archen
entry: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.

name: Archen
entry: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

name: Archen
entry: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

name: Archeops
entry: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph .

name: Archeops
entry: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

name: Archeops
entry: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.

name: Archeops
entry: Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph .

name: Archeops
entry: They hunted in flocks. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.

name: Archeops
entry: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.

name: Archeops
entry: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

name: Archeops
entry: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph , building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles .

name: Trubbish
entry: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Trubbish
entry: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Trubbish
entry: If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.

name: Trubbish
entry: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

name: Trubbish
entry: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of gas will put a person in the hospital.

name: Trubbish
entry: Poisonous gas leaks out of it when it breathes. Muk that catch a whiff of that stench will come drooling.

name: Trubbish
entry: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

name: Trubbish
entry: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
entry: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

name: Garbodor
entry: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Garbodor
entry: Some say the reason Garbodor in Alola are a little stronger than their counterparts elsewhere is the presence of Muk, their natural enemy.

name: Garbodor
entry: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

name: Garbodor
entry: For a time, their numbers increased explosively in Alola. Since the arrival of Grimer, their population has decreased dramatically.

name: Garbodor
entry: It locks opponents in place with its left hand, immobilizing them by entirely dousing their bodies with poisonous liquid.

name: Garbodor
entry: It sprays toxic gas from its mouth and fingers. If the gas engulfs you, the toxins will seep in all the way down to your bones.

name: Garbodor
entry: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Garbodor
entry: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Garbodor
entry: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon's toxic gas has become much thicker, congealing into masses shaped like discarded toys.

name: Zorua
entry: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zorua
entry: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

name: Zorua
entry: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

name: Zorua
entry: This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it's not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.

name: Zorua
entry: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Zorua
entry: Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua's ability to take on the forms of other creatures.

name: Zorua
entry: Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua does this, it usually takes on the form of a child.

name: Zorua
entry: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
entry: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Zoroark
entry: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Zoroark
entry: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

name: Zoroark
entry: It doesn't just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.

name: Zoroark
entry: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Zoroark
entry: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.

name: Zoroark
entry: Seeking to ease the burden of solitude, lonely Trainers tell Zoroark to show illusions to them.

name: Zoroark
entry: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.

name: Minccino
entry: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Minccino
entry: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

name: Minccino
entry: When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a whole day washing its tail in clean spring water.

name: Minccino
entry: A clean freak that will not allow even the slightest mess, it uses its tail like a mop to thoroughly clean any and all filth.

name: Minccino
entry: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

name: Minccino
entry: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Minccino
entry: These Pokémon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

name: Minccino
entry: When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a whole day washing its tail in clean springwater.

name: Cinccino
entry: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

name: Cinccino
entry: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Cinccino
entry: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

name: Cinccino
entry: The white parts of its coat are covered in an oil secreted from its body, so this Pokémon can slide right away from its enemies' attacks.

name: Cinccino
entry: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

name: Cinccino
entry: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Cinccino
entry: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Gothita
entry: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

name: Gothita
entry: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothita
entry: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it's speaking to something only it can see.

name: Gothita
entry: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

name: Gothita
entry: Beware of touching the ribbon-shaped feelers that control its psychic power. Gothita will begin bawling if you do.

name: Gothita
entry: This Pokémon is normally very innocent. When it is staring at something invisible, it is unblinking and utterly silent.

name: Gothorita
entry: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.

name: Gothorita
entry: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothorita
entry: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon's psychic power is at its strongest. It's unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

name: Gothorita
entry: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

name: Gothorita
entry: Using its psychic power, it arranges pebbles to form the shapes of constellations. Some people believe this Pokémon came from outer space.

name: Gothorita
entry: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

name: Gothitelle
entry: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

name: Gothitelle
entry: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Gothitelle
entry: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

name: Gothitelle
entry: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

name: Gothitelle
entry: It gazes at the stars to predict the future. It acts somewhat detached because it has seen the end of all existence.

name: Gothitelle
entry: Gothitelle unleashes psychic energy and shows opponents dreams of the universe’s end. These dreams are apparently ethereal and beautiful.

name: Solosis
entry: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Solosis
entry: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

name: Solosis
entry: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon's body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Solosis
entry: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

name: Solosis
entry: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

name: Duosion
entry: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

name: Duosion
entry: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Duosion
entry: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Duosion
entry: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

name: Duosion
entry: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

name: Reuniclus
entry: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Reuniclus
entry: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

name: Reuniclus
entry: It's said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Reuniclus
entry: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

name: Reuniclus
entry: Their arms are made of a special liquid. They use psychic power to control these arms and crush boulders.

name: Ducklett
entry: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Ducklett
entry: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Ducklett
entry: It strengthens its body by diving in to the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

name: Ducklett
entry: It's not very good at flying yet. It watches the dances of its Swanna parents to learn how to move its wings.

name: Swanna
entry: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Swanna
entry: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Swanna
entry: It's said that many artists have taken inspiration from the sight of Swanna performing a beautiful dance in the light of dawn.

name: Swanna
entry: Centered around its leader, the flock dances in perfect sync to strengthen its unity.

name: Vanillite
entry: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

name: Vanillite
entry: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit . They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: Vanillite
entry: When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not to melt, and thus Vanillite was born. At night, it buries itself in snow to sleep.

name: Vanillite
entry: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

name: Vanillite
entry: It feels pleasantly cool when embraced. This Pokémon is treasured by households in warm regions.

name: Vanillite
entry: It exhales cold air that is at –58 degrees Fahrenheit . When it's in a warm place, it shrinks little by little.

name: Vanillite
entry: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillite
entry: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Vanillite
entry: The temperature of their breath is −58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: Vanillish
entry: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

name: Vanillish
entry: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Vanillish
entry: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It's incredibly popular in very hot regions.

name: Vanillish
entry: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.

name: Vanillish
entry: This Pokémon has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.

name: Vanillish
entry: It sprays its enemies with grains of ice to freeze them. Most Vanillish in Alola are smaller than average.

name: Vanillish
entry: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit , freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanillish
entry: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted by the day's light, stick to each other and freeze together in the cold return of night.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: Even if it loses one of its heads, it can live relatively problem-free. It makes snow clouds inside its body.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: It blasts blizzards from its two mouths. It can create snow anywhere, so it gets a lot of love from skiers and snowboarders.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Vanilluxe
entry: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard from its horn, burying everything in snow.

name: Deerling
entry: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Deerling
entry: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

name: Deerling
entry: This Pokémon will playfully headbutt those it gets along well with. It has antlers hidden under its flower, so the headbutts are a little painful.

name: Deerling
entry: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In early spring, these Pokémon give off a delicate, sweet, and calming scent.

name: Deerling
entry: Despite Deerling's adorable appearance, farmers consider it a nuisance since it loves plant shoots and will eat them all up.

name: Deerling
entry: To prevent Deerling from entering their fields, many farmers will have several Lycanroc stand guard, as they are the natural enemy of Deerling.

name: Deerling
entry: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. When a distinct grassy smell starts to waft from one, you know that summer has begun.

name: Deerling
entry: These Pokémon are not shy—they will behave as they please, even in front of people. If you feed one of them, it will quickly take a liking to you.

name: Deerling
entry: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

name: Deerling
entry: Deerling’s scent changes with the seasons, but when the Pokémon is in its Winter Form, it has hardly any scent at all.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: Though there are many enthusiasts for Sawsbuck as a species, this seasonal form in particular is not very popular.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: It seems that a Sawsbuck with many flowers on its antlers will grow at a slightly slower pace because the flowers absorb the Pokémon’s nutrients.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The paler the pink flowers that bloom on its antlers, the more beautiful the Sawsbuck is considered to be.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The thicker and larger the branches and leaves on its antlers, the more majestic the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: This Pokémon's leaves can be made into a black tea, the taste of which varies depending on the region of origin. Paldea's is especially aromatic.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The darker the red of the foliage that hangs from its antlers, the more stylish the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: It’s said that Sawsbuck are calm and easy to tame during the season when they take on this form, so it’s the perfect time to make one your partner.

name: Emolga
entry: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

name: Emolga
entry: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

name: Emolga
entry: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

name: Emolga
entry: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

name: Emolga
entry: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

name: Emolga
entry: They store up electricity to fly through the air. When thunder cracks at night, sometimes there are almost enough of them to blot out the sky.

name: Emolga
entry: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can't fly properly.

name: Emolga
entry: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Emolga
entry: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its patagial membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Karrablast
entry: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet .

name: Karrablast
entry: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet .

name: Karrablast
entry: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet 's shell. Karrablast doesn't eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

name: Karrablast
entry: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Escavalier
entry: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet . The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Escavalier
entry: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet , they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Escavalier
entry: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch'd .

name: Escavalier
entry: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

name: Foongus
entry: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases poison spores.

name: Foongus
entry: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Foongus
entry: The spores released from this Pokémon's hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

name: Foongus
entry: No one knows what the Poké Ball-like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

name: Foongus
entry: This Pokémon prefers damp places. It spurts out poison spores to repel approaching enemies.

name: Foongus
entry: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

name: Amoonguss
entry: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

name: Amoonguss
entry: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Amoonguss
entry: Amoonguss generally doesn't move as much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

name: Amoonguss
entry: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

name: Amoonguss
entry: Amoonguss mimics Poké Balls. It is not yet clear whether this mimicry is effective against other Pokémon.

name: Amoonguss
entry: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss’s caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

name: Frillish
entry: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

name: Frillish
entry: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

name: Frillish
entry: Using the invisible poison spikes on its veillike arms and legs, it paralyzes its enemies and causes them to drown.

name: Frillish
entry: It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.

name: Frillish
entry: Its thin, veillike arms have tens of thousands of poisonous stingers. Females have slightly longer stingers. *

name: Frillish
entry: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean's surface.

name: Frillish
entry: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon. *

name: Jellicent
entry: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

name: Jellicent
entry: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Jellicent
entry: Fishermen are terrified of Jellicent. It's rumored to drag them into the sea and steal their lives away.

name: Jellicent
entry: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.

name: Jellicent
entry: The crown on its head gets bigger and bigger as it absorbs more and more of the life-force of other creatures. *

name: Jellicent
entry: Most of this Pokémon's body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair. *

name: Jellicent
entry: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear. *

name: Jellicent
entry: These Pokémon have body compositions that are mostly identical to seawater. They make their lairs from sunken ships. *

name: Alomomola
entry: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

name: Alomomola
entry: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Alomomola
entry: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

name: Alomomola
entry: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

name: Alomomola
entry: They float upon the open sea. Many water Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.

name: Alomomola
entry: Fishermen take them along on long voyages, because if you have an Alomomola with you, there'll be no need for a doctor or medicine.

name: Joltik
entry: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Joltik
entry: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

name: Joltik
entry: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They're often found sticking to Yamper's hindquarters.

name: Joltik
entry: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

name: Joltik
entry: Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

name: Joltik
entry: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: Galvantula
entry: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Galvantula
entry: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Galvantula
entry: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Galvantula
entry: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Ferroseed
entry: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Ferroseed
entry: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Ferroseed
entry: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferroseed
entry: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
entry: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Ferrothorn
entry: By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.

name: Ferrothorn
entry: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Ferrothorn
entry: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Klink
entry: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Klink
entry: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

name: Klink
entry: It's suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people's invention of the first gears.

name: Klink
entry: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
entry: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn't return, it will die.

name: Klang
entry: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

name: Klang
entry: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

name: Klang
entry: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Tynamo
entry: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Tynamo
entry: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Tynamo
entry: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Tynamo
entry: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

name: Eelektrik
entry: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektrik
entry: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektrik
entry: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes them with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektrik
entry: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross
entry: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Eelektross
entry: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Eelektross
entry: It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.

name: Eelektross
entry: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

name: Eelektross
entry: With their sucker mouths, they latch on to prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Elgyem
entry: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Elgyem
entry: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Elgyem
entry: This Pokémon is shrouded in mystery. It's said to have appeared from a UFO that fell from the sky about 50 years ago.

name: Elgyem
entry: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

name: Elgyem
entry: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

name: Elgyem
entry: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

name: Beheeyem
entry: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

name: Beheeyem
entry: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

name: Beheeyem
entry: It has strong psychic powers. Using its fingers that flash three different colors, it controls its opponents and rewrites their memories.

name: Beheeyem
entry: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.

name: Beheeyem
entry: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

name: Beheeyem
entry: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

name: Litwick
entry: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Litwick
entry: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Litwick
entry: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Litwick
entry: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

name: Litwick
entry: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when Litwick absorbs life-force from people or Pokémon.

name: Litwick
entry: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life-force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
entry: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

name: Lampent
entry: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Lampent
entry: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Lampent
entry: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

name: Lampent
entry: Lampent appears at the moment of death and promptly absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body.

name: Chandelure
entry: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

name: Chandelure
entry: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Chandelure
entry: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it's said.

name: Chandelure
entry: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Chandelure
entry: One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.

name: Chandelure
entry: It absorbs spirits, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Axew
entry: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

name: Axew
entry: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Axew
entry: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn't a concern.

name: Axew
entry: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

name: Axew
entry: If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.

name: Axew
entry: This Pokémon lives in nests that are made in the ground. People in ancient times used its tusks as cooking knives.

name: Fraxure
entry: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

name: Fraxure
entry: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

name: Fraxure
entry: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure's favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

name: Fraxure
entry: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

name: Fraxure
entry: Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into two portions—one to eat now and one to save for later.

name: Fraxure
entry: Because its tusks don’t grow back once they break, this Pokémon apparently won’t use them unless truly necessary.

name: Haxorus
entry: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

name: Haxorus
entry: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Haxorus
entry: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

name: Haxorus
entry: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

name: Haxorus
entry: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Haxorus
entry: This Pokémon nests in caves and abandoned mines. It is docile, but it will become incredibly angry if its tusks are touched, so beware.

name: Cubchoo
entry: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

name: Cubchoo
entry: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Cubchoo
entry: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

name: Cubchoo
entry: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

name: Cubchoo
entry: When Cubchoo starts sneezing, watch out! If it spatters you with its frosty snot, you'll get frostbite.

name: Cubchoo
entry: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

name: Beartic
entry: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

name: Beartic
entry: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

name: Beartic
entry: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

name: Beartic
entry: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

name: Beartic
entry: Feared as the Snow-White Demon in northern lands, Beartic uses its frosty claws and fangs to attack prey.

name: Beartic
entry: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

name: Cryogonal
entry: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Cryogonal
entry: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Cryogonal
entry: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

name: Cryogonal
entry: With its icy chains, Cryogonal freezes those it encounters. It then takes its victims away to somewhere unknown.

name: Cryogonal
entry: Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its opponents and then flash-freezes them where they stand.

name: Cryogonal
entry: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

name: Shelmet
entry: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast . The reason is still unknown.

name: Shelmet
entry: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Shelmet
entry: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast , Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Shelmet
entry: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast , however, because they can still get into the shell.

name: Accelgor
entry: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: Accelgor
entry: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Accelgor
entry: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Accelgor
entry: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

name: Stunfisk
entry: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Stunfisk
entry: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Stunfisk
entry: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

name: Stunfisk
entry: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

name: Stunfisk
entry: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

name: Stunfisk
entry: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

name: Mienfoo
entry: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienfoo
entry: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

name: Mienfoo
entry: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

name: Mienfoo
entry: They can often be seen in packs in the morning, slowly moving their bodies through a series of poses.

name: Mienfoo
entry: Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be met with a flurry of attacks.

name: Mienfoo
entry: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
entry: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

name: Mienshao
entry: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Mienshao
entry: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

name: Mienshao
entry: It overwhelms its opponents with continuous attacks and then slowly stores up power before delivering the finishing blow.

name: Mienshao
entry: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Mienshao
entry: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

name: Druddigon
entry: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Druddigon
entry: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Druddigon
entry: It infiltrates tunnels that Pokémon like Diglett and Dugtrio have dug and quietly waits for prey to pass through.

name: Druddigon
entry: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

name: Druddigon
entry: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Druddigon
entry: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won't be able to move if its body gets too cold.

name: Golett
entry: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

name: Golett
entry: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golett
entry: Although ancient people apparently built it by working with clay, the source of its energy is unclear.

name: Golett
entry: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.

name: Golett
entry: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golett
entry: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golett
entry: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

name: Golurk
entry: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Golurk
entry: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Golurk
entry: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.

name: Golurk
entry: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master's orders faithfully.

name: Golurk
entry: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.

name: Golurk
entry: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

name: Golurk
entry: Golurk were created by ancient people to protect both people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

name: Golurk
entry: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately. During such rampages, it can turn a whole town into a mountain of rubble.

name: Pawniard
entry: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Pawniard
entry: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Pawniard
entry: It follows Bisharp's orders to a tee when it attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent, Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.

name: Pawniard
entry: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

name: Pawniard
entry: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Pawniard
entry: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Pawniard
entry: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

name: Pawniard
entry: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

name: Bisharp
entry: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Bisharp
entry: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

name: Bisharp
entry: It leads a group of Pawniard. Bisharp doesn't even change its expression when it deals the finishing blow to an opponent.

name: Bisharp
entry: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

name: Bisharp
entry: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

name: Bisharp
entry: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

name: Bisharp
entry: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

name: Bisharp
entry: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

name: Bouffalant
entry: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Bouffalant
entry: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: Bouffalant
entry: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Bouffalant
entry: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

name: Rufflet
entry: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Rufflet
entry: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

name: Rufflet
entry: Known as a natural-born warrior, soon after its hatching, it will challenge its parent to a fight in order to gain their acceptance.

name: Rufflet
entry: They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow stronger and more powerful each time they faint or are injured.

name: Rufflet
entry: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

name: Rufflet
entry: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.

name: Rufflet
entry: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Rufflet
entry: If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can't resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.

name: Rufflet
entry: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.

name: Braviary
entry: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Braviary
entry: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Braviary
entry: Known as “the hero of the skies,” this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it's injured.

name: Braviary
entry: With its brave disposition, it fears nothing—not even death. Ancient Alolan people respected it, referring to it as "the hero of the sky."

name: Braviary
entry: It's thought that people disturbed their habitats in the past, so Braviary banded together to fight back.

name: Braviary
entry: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.

name: Braviary
entry: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Braviary
entry: Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokémon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.

name: Braviary
entry: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.

name: Braviary
entry: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

name: Vullaby
entry: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

name: Vullaby
entry: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

name: Vullaby
entry: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Vullaby
entry: It protects its plump posterior with the bones of prey it has consumed. As it grows, it replaces the bones.

name: Vullaby
entry: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

name: Vullaby
entry: Mandibuzz gives it the bones it wears. Vullaby's wings are short, so it can't fly yet, but it jumps around, dreaming of wide open skies.

name: Vullaby
entry: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

name: Vullaby
entry: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

name: Vullaby
entry: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: It's always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: It skillfully arranges the bones of its prey to construct its nest. Most of the bones are Cubone.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

name: Heatmor
entry: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

name: Heatmor
entry: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Heatmor
entry: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Heatmor
entry: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Durant
entry: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Durant
entry: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

name: Durant
entry: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda .

name: Durant
entry: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Deino
entry: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

name: Deino
entry: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Deino
entry: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Deino
entry: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

name: Deino
entry: It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce, so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that moves and attempt to eat it.

name: Deino
entry: It can’t see, so its first approach to examining things is to bite them. You will be covered in wounds until a Deino warms up to you.

name: Zweilous
entry: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Zweilous
entry: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Zweilous
entry: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Zweilous
entry: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

name: Zweilous
entry: The two heads have different likes and dislikes. Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

name: Zweilous
entry: The two heads do not get along at all. If you don’t give each head the same amount of attention, they’ll begin fighting out of jealousy.

name: Hydreigon
entry: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Hydreigon
entry: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Hydreigon
entry: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.

name: Hydreigon
entry: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

name: Hydreigon
entry: It's said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because people in times long past loathed it, considering it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

name: Hydreigon
entry: Only the central head has a brain. It is very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

name: Larvesta
entry: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Larvesta
entry: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

name: Larvesta
entry: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

name: Larvesta
entry: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Larvesta
entry: Larvesta's body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

name: Larvesta
entry: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

name: Larvesta
entry: In ancient times, Larvesta was worshiped as the emissary of the sun. However, it was also viewed as a burden since it often caused forest fires.

name: Larvesta
entry: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

name: Volcarona
entry: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Volcarona
entry: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Volcarona
entry: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

name: Volcarona
entry: As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as "the rage of the sun."

name: Volcarona
entry: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

name: Volcarona
entry: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it's trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

name: Volcarona
entry: This Pokémon scatters burning scales. Most of the danger of these scales is not in their heat—it's in the way they rob the surrounding air of oxygen.

name: Volcarona
entry: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

name: Cobalion
entry: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Cobalion
entry: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Cobalion
entry: From the moment it's born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

name: Cobalion
entry: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion , fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.

name: Terrakion
entry: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.

name: Terrakion
entry: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Terrakion
entry: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

name: Terrakion
entry: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Virizion
entry: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

name: Virizion
entry: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Virizion
entry: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

name: Virizion
entry: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

name: Tornadus
entry: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Tornadus
entry: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph .

name: Tornadus
entry: An example of what is known as a “form change,” though I suspect this strange avian guise to be Tornadus's true form. Tornadus has been sighted crossing the ocean while in this form.

name: Tornadus
entry: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

name: Thundurus
entry: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

name: Thundurus
entry: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Thundurus
entry: Quick as a flash, it materializes out of nowhere. It pulverizes foes into nothingness with showers of devastatingly powerful lightning bolts launched from the string of orbs on its tail.

name: Thundurus
entry: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

name: Reshiram
entry: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Reshiram
entry: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Reshiram
entry: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down. *

name: Reshiram
entry: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It's said that this Pokémon will scorch the world. *

name: Zekrom
entry: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Zekrom
entry: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

name: Zekrom
entry: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom's lightning. *

name: Zekrom
entry: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings. *

name: Landorus
entry: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Landorus
entry: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Landorus
entry: Landorus soars through the sky in this form, bestowing plentiful harvests upon the land and earning the people's reverence. It can traverse the whole of Hisui in a mere couple of hours.

name: Landorus
entry: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

name: Kyurem
entry: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Kyurem
entry: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Kyurem
entry: The sameness of Zekrom 's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Zekrom. Kyurem can now use the power of both electricity and ice. *

name: Kyurem
entry: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom , but the extreme cold keeps that power bound. *

name: Kyurem
entry: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure. *

name: Kyurem
entry: The sameness of Reshiram 's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Reshiram. Kyurem can now use the power of both fire and ice. *

name: Kyurem
entry: It has foreseen that a world of truth will arrive for people and Pokémon. It strives to protect that future. *

name: Kyurem
entry: It's said that this Pokémon battles in order to protect the ideal world that will exist in the future for people and Pokémon. *

name: Keldeo
entry: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Keldeo
entry: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Keldeo
entry: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything. *

name: Keldeo
entry: Cobalion , Terrakion , and Virizion taught this Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training. *

name: Keldeo
entry: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon's true power will awaken. *

name: Keldeo
entry: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle, filling its body with power and changing its form. *

name: Meloetta
entry: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Meloetta
entry: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Genesect
entry: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Genesect
entry: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Chespin
entry: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

name: Chespin
entry: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Chespin
entry: When Chespin tenses up just before landing a headbutt, the spikes on its head sharpen to points, piercing the enemy’s body on contact.

name: Chespin
entry: Eating lots of berries makes the bark shell that covers Chespin’s head and body grow sturdier.

name: Quilladin
entry: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

name: Quilladin
entry: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

name: Quilladin
entry: It’s protected by a sturdy shell. The shell is also very heavy, which naturally strengthens Quilladin’s lower body.

name: Quilladin
entry: It can send a trailer flying with a tackle. It’s numb to pain, so even violent collisions don’t faze it.

name: Chesnaught
entry: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

name: Chesnaught
entry: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Chesnaught
entry: It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.

name: Chesnaught
entry: When its allies are in trouble, Chesnaught creates a shield with its arms and uses its own body to block attacks.

name: Chesnaught
entry: Its gentle disposition would have it avoid conflict, but it gives opponents a thrashing with its thorned fists when the situation calls for it.

name: Chesnaught
entry: Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Fennekin
entry: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Fennekin
entry: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Fennekin
