entry: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Fennekin
entry: This Pokémon gets worked up easily. Its body can also overheat, so it uses its ears to dissipate the heat and calm down.

name: Fennekin
entry: Twigs make for Fennekin’s snacks. When it nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face strong foes.

name: Braixen
entry: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Braixen
entry: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Braixen
entry: It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Braixen
entry: It ignites the twig from its tail and waves the twig around to signal its allies. To indicate danger, it draws circles in the air with the twig’s flame.

name: Braixen
entry: Braixen’s branch ignites as it’s pulled from the Pokémon’s tail. Braixen then uses the flame to spark powerful attacks.

name: Delphox
entry: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit , incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Delphox
entry: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

name: Delphox
entry: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.

name: Delphox
entry: It leaves burn marks in the ground with the flame at the tip of its wand. Long ago, people used the shapes of these burn marks for divination.

name: Delphox
entry: It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.

name: Delphox
entry: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Froakie
entry: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Froakie
entry: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Froakie
entry: Its happy-go-lucky look is an act intended to fool its enemies. It will suddenly drop the facade and overwhelm its foes with its blinding speed.

name: Froakie
entry: It utilizes its extraordinary jumping abilities to flummox its foes, throwing springy bubbles at them from above their heads.

name: Frogadier
entry: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Frogadier
entry: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Frogadier
entry: It excels at devising battle strategies that make use of the terrain, and it never misses its mark when throwing bubble-covered pebbles.

name: Frogadier
entry: The tips of its fingers and toes stick firmly to vertical surfaces. Frogadier can scale skyscrapers with ease.

name: Greninja
entry: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Greninja
entry: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Greninja
entry: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.

name: Greninja
entry: The movement of air against the long tongue Greninja keeps wrapped around its neck allows it to sense enemies it can’t see.

name: Greninja
entry: It makes shuriken out of mucus excreted from its thighs. These shuriken can cut cleanly through steel cables.

name: Bunnelby
entry: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

name: Bunnelby
entry: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Bunnelby
entry: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Bunnelby
entry: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Bunnelby
entry: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through without rest.

name: Diggersby
entry: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

name: Diggersby
entry: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Diggersby
entry: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Diggersby
entry: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

name: Fletchling
entry: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

name: Fletchling
entry: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Fletchling
entry: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Fletchling
entry: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.

name: Fletchling
entry: When it's excited, its temperature can double, spiking hormone production in its body.

name: Fletchling
entry: While it's an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.

name: Fletchling
entry: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

name: Fletchling
entry: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

name: Fletchling
entry: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Fletchling
entry: Fletchling can be found in both rural and urban areas. They once had a huge territorial dispute with Squawkabilly . Fights broke out all over town.

name: Fletchinder
entry: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

name: Fletchinder
entry: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Fletchinder
entry: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

name: Fletchinder
entry: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.

name: Fletchinder
entry: It will not tolerate other Fletchinder entering its territory, which has a radius of several miles.

name: Fletchinder
entry: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

name: Fletchinder
entry: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

name: Fletchinder
entry: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

name: Fletchinder
entry: The hotter the flame sac in its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

name: Fletchinder
entry: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Fletchinder
entry: Its territory has a radius of just over a mile. If any bird Pokémon should enter, it will show them no mercy.

entry: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph . It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

name: Talonflame
entry: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: Talonflame
entry: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

name: Talonflame
entry: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek . It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.

name: Talonflame
entry: It zooms directly at its prey at flight speeds of close to 310 mph , while fiery embers scatter from gaps in its feathers.

name: Talonflame
entry: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

name: Talonflame
entry: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

name: Talonflame
entry: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

name: Talonflame
entry: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers as it flies.

name: Talonflame
entry: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs .

name: Talonflame
entry: When it gets excited, it vents sparks from the gaps between its feathers. These unburnable feathers are used as a fireproof material.

name: Scatterbug

name: Scatterbug

name: Scatterbug
entry: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

entry: The beaks of bird Pokémon can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Spewpa
entry: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: Spewpa

name: Litleo
entry: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Litleo
entry: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Litleo
entry: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Litleo
entry: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

name: Litleo
entry: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot- blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Litleo
entry: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.

name: Litleo
entry: The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane will grow.

name: Pyroar
entry: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit , they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

name: Pyroar
entry: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Pyroar
entry: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit , but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Pyroar
entry: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

name: Pyroar
entry: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit . It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.

name: Pyroar
entry: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It’s thanks to them that their pride doesn’t starve.

name: Pyroar
entry: The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit during battle. Merely approaching it will cause severe burns.

name: Flabébé
entry: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

name: Flabébé
entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: Flabébé
entry: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Flabébé
entry: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

name: Flabébé
entry: When evening falls, it searches out a place blooming with flowers of the same white color as its own flower, and then it goes to sleep.

name: Flabébé
entry: This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden within blooming wild flowers. It is particularly fond of red flowers.

name: Flabébé

name: Flabébé
entry: This Flabébé rides a yellow flower. The Pokémon is defenseless and vulnerable before it has found and received power from a flower.

name: Flabébé
entry: It unleashes a variety of moves by drawing forth the power hidden within flowers. This Pokémon is particularly fond of yellow flowers.

name: Flabébé
entry: This Flabébé rides an orange flower. On its head, it wears a crown of pollen that has healing properties.

name: Flabébé
entry: It receives strength from flowers and gives them some of its energy in return. This Pokémon likes orange flowers best of all.

name: Flabébé
entry: Once it finds a flower it likes, this Pokémon will spend the rest of its life taking care of its flower. This Flabébé rides a blue flower.

name: Flabébé

name: Flabébé

name: Floette

name: Floette

name: Floette

name: Floette

entry: This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden within yellow flowers. This power then becomes the moves Floette uses to protect itself.

name: Floette

name: Floette
entry: This Pokémon can draw forth the most power when in sync with orange flowers, compared to flowers of other colors.

name: Floette

name: Floette

name: Floette
entry: It exchanges power with flowers via wavelengths of visible light. This form of Floette can sync with the wavelength that produces the color blue.

name: Floette
entry: Floette that are fond of white flowers can also easily sync with flowers of other colors.

name: Floette
entry: If it finds someone messing up a flower bed, it will attack them without mercy. This Floette takes particularly good care of white flowers.

name: Floette
entry: This rare Floette holds a plant that died out in ancient times. The Pokémon is said to harbor an incredible power.

name: Florges

name: Florges

name: Florges

name: Florges
entry: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

name: Florges
entry: A flower garden made by a white-flowered Florges will be beautifully decorated with flowering plants of many different colors.

name: Florges
entry: This Pokémon creates an impressive flower garden in its territory. It draws forth the power of the red flowers around its neck.

name: Florges
entry: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

name: Florges
entry: They say that flower gardens created by Florges constantly emit a power that can heal both body and spirit.

name: Florges
entry: It is said that there was once a Florges that protected the garden of a castle for over 300 years.

name: Florges
entry: This Pokémon battles by drawing forth the power of yellow flowers. It ruthlessly punishes anyone who tramples on flowering plants.

name: Florges
entry: Its orange flowers fire off powerful beams, attacking as if they were a battery of artillery.

name: Florges
entry: In times long past, castle governors would lovingly raise Florges to care for their castles' exquisite gardens.

name: Florges
entry: When Florges attacks, its orange flowers fire off powerful beams as if they were a battery of artillery.

name: Florges
entry: Though usually compassionate, Florges will hunt down anyone who vandalizes its flower garden, showing no mercy even if they beg for their lives.

name: Florges
entry: Blue pigments were tremendously expensive in the past, so paintings of blue Florges are highly valuable.

name: Skiddo
entry: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Skiddo
entry: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Skiddo
entry: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the back of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

name: Skiddo
entry: As long as it has sunlight and water, Skiddo can make energy with the leaves on its body, allowing it to live on rocky mountains barren of food.

name: Gogoat
entry: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Gogoat
entry: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: Gogoat
entry: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in their grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets human and Pokémon run as if one being.

name: Gogoat
entry: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

name: Gogoat
entry: These Pokémon live in herds in mountainous places. The victor in their contests of clashing horns will become the leader of the herd.

name: Pancham
entry: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Pancham
entry: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Pancham
entry: It's desperate to intimidate its opponents. Be nice and pretend to be scared if you catch it glaring at you intensely.

name: Pancham
entry: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

name: Pancham
entry: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

name: Pancham
entry: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

name: Pancham
entry: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Pancham
entry: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

name: Pangoro
entry: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

name: Pangoro
entry: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

name: Pangoro
entry: Pangoro is the type to talk with its fists. It doesn't say much as it pummels opponents with enough force to send a dump truck flying.

name: Pangoro
entry: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

name: Pangoro
entry: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

name: Pangoro
entry: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

name: Pangoro
entry: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Pangoro
entry: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon .

name: Pangoro
entry: Although it has a violent temperament, it won't put up with those who bully the weak. It senses foes' movements with its leaf.

name: Furfrou
entry: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

name: Furfrou
entry: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Furfrou
entry: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Furfrou
entry: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou's fur into the most exquisite style.

name: Espurr
entry: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

name: Espurr
entry: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Espurr
entry: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

name: Espurr
entry: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

name: Espurr
entry: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

name: Espurr
entry: It keeps its ears covered to prevent the intense psychic power in its body from escaping, but it falls unconscious if this power builds too much.

name: Espurr
entry: Behind an Espurr’s expressionless face is a frantic struggle to contain psychic power.

name: Meowstic
entry: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

name: Meowstic
entry: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Meowstic
entry: If it doesn't hold back when it unleashes its psychic power, it can tear apart a tanker. Its unfriendliness is part of its charm.

name: Meowstic
entry: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.

name: Meowstic
entry: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Meowstic
entry: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

name: Meowstic
entry: Though it has enough psychic power to blast away any opponent, Meowstic prefers to support its allies rather than attack.

name: Meowstic
entry: If Meowstic continuously emits its powerful psychic energy, it will damage its own body.

name: Meowstic
entry: Female Meowstic are more aggressive than males. Their expression remains blank even while they're wielding immense psychic power.

name: Meowstic
entry: When they sense danger, they exert their psychic power at its maximum output. They have no regard for their opponents.

name: Honedge
entry: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Honedge
entry: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Honedge
entry: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

name: Honedge
entry: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

name: Honedge
entry: Apparently Honedge was born when a departed spirit began inhabiting an ancient sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Doublade
entry: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

name: Doublade
entry: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Doublade
entry: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Doublade
entry: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

name: Doublade
entry: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Aegislash
entry: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

name: Aegislash
entry: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Aegislash
entry: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Aegislash
entry: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

name: Aegislash
entry: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Aegislash
entry: This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.

name: Aegislash
entry: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to rule.

name: Spritzee
entry: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

name: Spritzee
entry: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Spritzee
entry: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Spritzee
entry: A scent pouch within this Pokémon's body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.

name: Aromatisse
entry: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

name: Aromatisse

name: Aromatisse
entry: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokémon's companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.

name: Aromatisse
entry: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless they happen to really enjoy the smell, Trainers will have a hard time walking alongside it.

name: Swirlix
entry: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Swirlix
entry: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Swirlix
entry: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Swirlix
entry: To entangle and immobilize its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff

name: Slurpuff
entry: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

name: Slurpuff

name: Inkay
entry: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

name: Inkay
entry: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Inkay

name: Inkay
entry: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

name: Inkay
entry: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

name: Inkay
entry: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Inkay
entry: It drains foes' will to fight by flashing light at them. It then takes the opportunity to hide itself away.

name: Inkay
entry: It protects itself from tough foes by flashing its luminescent spots to discourage them.

name: Inkay
entry: Being upside-down improves its blood flow and clears its mind, causing the power of its psychic moves to increase dramatically.

name: Malamar

name: Malamar
entry: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Malamar
entry: It flashes the pattern on its torso to control its prey and draw them in. The edges of its fins are supremely sharp.

name: Malamar

name: Malamar
entry: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Malamar
entry: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

name: Malamar
entry: It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personalities and memories of others—and to control them.

name: Malamar
entry: Its hypnotic powers are dangerously strong. Anyone who falls under Malamar’s control loses their memories surrounding the event.

name: Malamar
entry: It flashes the luminescent spots on its body to hypnotize its opponents, gaining total control over them.

name: Binacle

name: Binacle
entry: If the two don't work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won't survive.

name: Binacle
entry: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

entry: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

name: Barbaracle

name: Barbaracle
entry: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy's defeat.

name: Barbaracle
entry: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Barbaracle
entry: It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.

name: Skrelp
entry: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

name: Skrelp
entry: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

name: Skrelp

name: Skrelp
entry: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

name: Skrelp
entry: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

name: Skrelp
entry: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

name: Skrelp
entry: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, this Pokémon sprays liquid poison to take down prey that approach unawares.

name: Skrelp
entry: Skrelp evades its enemies by hiding amid drifting seaweed. It eats rotten seaweed to create its poison.

name: Skrelp
entry: This Pokémon is a poor swimmer. If it's caught in a fierce storm, it will sometimes get washed far away and become unable to return to its home.

name: Dragalge
entry: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

name: Dragalge
entry: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

name: Dragalge
entry: It blends in with seaweed to ambush its prey and then takes them down with a poisonous liquid strong enough to melt metal.

name: Dragalge
entry: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise .

name: Dragalge
entry: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean's surface and bathing it in sunlight.

name: Dragalge
entry: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

name: Dragalge
entry: It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.

name: Dragalge
entry: Using a liquid poison, Dragalge indiscriminately attacks anything that wanders into its territory. This poison can corrode the undersides of boats.

name: Dragalge
entry: Since Finizen is the better swimmer, Dragalge will approach it under the cover of seaweed, then immobilize it with a poisonous attack.

name: Clauncher
entry: Through controlled explosions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

name: Clauncher
entry: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

name: Clauncher
entry: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it's terrible at swimming straight.

name: Clauncher
entry: Its claws occasionally fall off, and it keeps a low profile until they grow back. The meat of its claws is so delicious!

name: Clauncher
entry: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

name: Clauncher
entry: Clauncher's claws can fall off during battle, but they'll regenerate. The meat inside the claws is popular as a delicacy in Galar.

name: Clauncher
entry: This Pokémon launches water by detonating gas inside its right claw. It snipes flying Pokémon.

name: Clauncher
entry: Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

name: Clawitzer
entry: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

name: Clawitzer
entry: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

name: Clawitzer
entry: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it's exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.

name: Clawitzer
entry: It compresses the water it has sucked up and then projects it with enough power to punch a hole right through a thick sheet of iron.

name: Clawitzer
entry: Clawitzer's right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer's cannon arm can sink a tanker.

name: Clawitzer
entry: After using the feelers on its oversized claw to detect the location of prey, Clawitzer launches a cannonball of water at its target.

name: Clawitzer
entry: Clawitzer can move through the water at a speed of 60 knots by using gas inside its body to expel water from the back of its claw.

name: Clawitzer
entry: The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer launches from its claw are powerful enough to punch through tanker hulls.

name: Helioptile
entry: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Helioptile
entry: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Helioptile
entry: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Helioptile
entry: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
entry: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

name: Heliolisk
entry: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Heliolisk
entry: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Heliolisk
entry: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

name: Tyrunt
entry: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

name: Tyrunt
entry: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Tyrunt
entry: Tyrunt is spoiled and selfish. It may just be trying to frolic, but sometimes the ones it's trying to frolic with are gravely injured.

name: Tyrunt
entry: Its large jaw has incredible destructive power. Some theories suggest that its restored form is different from its form of long ago.

name: Tyrunt
entry: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

name: Tyrunt
entry: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern times. It has a violent disposition, and it'll tear apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.

name: Tyrantrum
entry: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

name: Tyrantrum
entry: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

name: Tyrantrum
entry: The king of the ancient world, it can easily crunch a car with the devastating strength of its enormous jaws.

name: Tyrantrum
entry: Complete restoration is impossible, allowing room for theories that its entire body was once covered in a feather-like coat.

name: Tyrantrum
entry: A single bite of Tyrantrum's massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Tyrantrum
entry: This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000 years ago. It has the presence of a king, vicious but magnificent.

name: Tyrantrum
entry: This Pokémon behaved like a king 100 million years ago. Nothing could stop it.

name: Amaura
entry: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

name: Amaura
entry: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

name: Amaura
entry: Amaura was restored successfully, but it's not expected to live long because of the heat of the current environment.

name: Amaura
entry: It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It's said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky.

name: Amaura
entry: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

name: Amaura
entry: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kind in cold lands where there were fewer predators.

name: Amaura
entry: This ancient Pokémon was restored from a part of its body that had been frozen in ice for 100 million years.

name: Aurorus
entry: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.

name: Aurorus
entry: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit , surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

name: Aurorus
entry: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a surface temperature of around –240 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Aurorus
entry: An Aurorus was found frozen solid within a glacier, just as it appeared long ago, which became quite a big event in the news.

name: Aurorus
entry: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Aurorus
entry: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It's said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.

name: Aurorus
entry: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as −240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

name: Sylveon
entry: It wraps its ribbonlike feelers around the arm of its beloved Trainer and walks with him or her.

name: Sylveon
entry: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Sylveon
entry: Sylveon wraps its ribbonlike feelers around its Trainer's arm because this touch enables it to read its Trainer's feelings.

name: Sylveon
entry: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. Then it attacks.

name: Sylveon
entry: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

name: Sylveon
entry: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

name: Sylveon
entry: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Sylveon
entry: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

name: Sylveon
entry: There's a Galarian fairy tale that describes a beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadful dragon Pokémon.

name: Sylveon
entry: It wraps its ribbonlike feelers around the arm of its beloved Trainer and walks with them.

name: Sylveon
entry: This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing their hostility.

name: Sylveon
entry: Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves aim straight for its opponents' weak spots.

name: Hawlucha
entry: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Hawlucha
entry: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama .

name: Hawlucha
entry: In combat, Hawlucha leaps nimbly about, taking advantage of its opponents' blind spots. It's also skilled at using superb submission holds.

name: Hawlucha
entry: It overwhelms opponents with quick moves, but sometimes it showboats for too long when it's using a special move and gets itself into a pinch.

name: Hawlucha
entry: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Hawlucha
entry: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Hawlucha
entry: Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.

name: Hawlucha
entry: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

name: Hawlucha
entry: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape .

name: Dedenne
entry: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

name: Dedenne
entry: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Dedenne
entry: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

name: Dedenne
entry: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

name: Dedenne
entry: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Dedenne
entry: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

name: Dedenne
entry: It’s small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people’s homes and charge itself.

name: Dedenne
entry: Dedenne emit electrical waves from the whiskers on their cheeks to communicate with each other. When low on electricity, they curl up and sleep.

name: Carbink
entry: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

name: Carbink
entry: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

name: Carbink
entry: To keep the jewels on their bodies free of tarnish, packs of Carbink use their soft manes to polish one another's jewels.

name: Carbink
entry: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

name: Carbink
entry: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

name: Carbink
entry: Some say that deep beneath the surface of the world, a pack of Carbink live with their queen in a kingdom of jewels.

name: Carbink
entry: It's said that somewhere in the world, there's a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It's also said that this pack has a queen .

name: Carbink
entry: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

name: Carbink
entry: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it releases energy from the stone in its head.

name: Goomy
entry: It's covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

name: Goomy
entry: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

name: Goomy
entry: Its body is mostly water. If it dries out, it will die, so it's always sitting with perfect stillness in the shade.

name: Goomy
entry: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it's unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.

name: Goomy
entry: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

name: Goomy
entry: It uses its horns to check out its surroundings. They're very sensitive, so if you grab them, it will feel a strong shock and be unable to move.

name: Goomy
entry: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Goomy
entry: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It's considered the weakest dragon Pokémon.

name: Goomy
entry: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.

name: Goomy
entry: Thanks to the slimy membrane covering its body, punches or kicks from its enemies slide right off it.

name: Goomy
entry: Most of a Goomy’s body is water. A membrane covers the whole Pokémon to prevent it from shriveling up in dry weather.

name: Goomy
entry: Goomy's horns are excellent sensory organs that cover all five of Goomy's senses. Goomy picks up on danger from the movement of the air.

name: Sliggoo
entry: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

name: Sliggoo
entry: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

name: Sliggoo
entry: Its entire body is covered with gooey mucus that can dissolve anything. Be sure to put gloves on if you're going to touch it.

name: Sliggoo
entry: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.

name: Sliggoo
entry: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

name: Sliggoo
entry: It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with its brain and other organs.

name: Sliggoo
entry: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Sliggoo
entry: Although this Pokémon isn't very strong, its body is coated in a caustic slime that can melt through anything, so predators steer clear of it.

name: Sliggoo
entry: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.

name: Sliggoo
entry: The iron in Sliggoo's drinking water turned its shell metallic. The Pokémon doesn't come out of its shell on sunny days.

name: Sliggoo
entry: The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with all its vital organs, such as its brain and heart.

name: Sliggoo
entry: When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus coating its entire body becomes more concentrated— it'll dissolve anything.

name: Goodra
entry: It attacks with retractable horns. It throws a punch that's the equivalent of the force of a hundred pro boxers.

name: Goodra
entry: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Goodra
entry: Underneath its slimy skin is a thick layer of fat, and the combination of the two makes enemies' attacks slide right off.

name: Goodra
entry: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.

name: Goodra
entry: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

name: Goodra
entry: It's very friendly toward people. If you grow close to it, Goodra will hug you with its sticky, slime-covered body. Don't get mad.

name: Goodra
entry: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Goodra
entry: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don't mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.

name: Goodra
entry: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

name: Goodra
entry: If anything bad happens to it, Goodra retreats into its shell and bounces around like a rubber ball, knocking down trees and boring into mountains.

name: Goodra
entry: It loves the rain. This mellow Pokémon can be seen walking around on the plains and in the mountains on rainy days.

name: Goodra
entry: This Pokémon is uncontrollable when enraged. It rampages on and on, lashing its tail with enough power to send a dump truck flying.

name: Goodra
entry: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Klefki
entry: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

name: Klefki
entry: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Klefki
entry: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.

name: Klefki
entry: This even-tempered Pokémon has a habit of collecting keys. It will sneak into people's homes to steal their keys.

name: Klefki
entry: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

name: Klefki
entry: Although it's unclear why it collects keys, giving it a key makes Klefki very happy. However, it apparently only likes master keys.

name: Klefki
entry: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

name: Klefki
entry: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

name: Klefki
entry: Once it absorbs a key’s metal ions, it discards the key without a second thought. However, it will hang on to keys it favors for decades.

name: Klefki
entry: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

name: Phantump
entry: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Phantump
entry: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

name: Phantump
entry: An unknown spirit came to lodge in a tree stump, creating this Pokémon. A cure-all can be made from an infusion of its green leaves.

name: Phantump
entry: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

name: Phantump
entry: According to legend, medicine to cure any illness can be made by plucking the green leaves on its head, brewing them, and boiling down the liquid.

name: Phantump
entry: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.

name: Phantump
entry: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Phantump
entry: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Phantump
entry: Legend tells that its green leaves can cure any illness. When plucked, however, the leaves will instantly wither away.

name: Phantump
entry: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

name: Trevenant
entry: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Trevenant
entry: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

name: Trevenant
entry: This Pokémon controls trees via roots stretching from its feet, and it will attack anyone that dares to ravage the forest.

name: Trevenant
entry: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.

name: Trevenant
entry: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

name: Trevenant
entry: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

name: Trevenant
entry: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Trevenant
entry: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

name: Trevenant
entry: Using its roots, Trevenant connects itself to trees and monitors every corner of its forest. It uses curses to drive intruders away.

name: Trevenant
entry: Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the forest. It doesn't even care if these Pokémon take up residence in the greenery on its head.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: Massive Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of areas where a great number of lost souls lingered.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: When taking spirits to the afterlife, small Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of children to those of adults.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: Small Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of areas where few lost souls lingered.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo's body. They're then moved on to the afterlife.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: When taking spirits to the afterlife, large Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of adults to those of children.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: Large Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of areas where many lost souls lingered.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: Supersized Pumpkaboo are very partial to the spirits of people who were of similarly superior proportions.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: In keeping with the size of its body, this variety of Pumpkaboo takes jumbo spirits to the afterlife.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: In keeping with the size of its body, this variety of Pumpkaboo takes the small spirits of children to the afterlife.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

name: Pumpkaboo
entry: In keeping with the size of its body, this variety of Pumpkaboo takes the large spirits of adults to the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist
entry: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.

name: Gourgeist
entry: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Gourgeist
entry: A supersized Pumpkaboo evolves into a supersized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

name: Gourgeist
entry: Small Gourgeist pretend to be children to fool adults. Anyone who falls for the act gets carried away to the hereafter.

name: Gourgeist
entry: A small-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a small-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

name: Gourgeist
entry: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist
entry: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist
entry: Large Gourgeist put on the guise of adults, taking the hands of children to lead them to the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist
entry: A large-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a large-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

name: Gourgeist
entry: Supersized Gourgeist aren't picky. They will forcefully drag anyone off to the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist
entry: Jumbo Gourgeist aren't picky. They will forcefully drag anyone off to the afterlife.

name: Bergmite
entry: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit , they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

name: Bergmite
entry: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

name: Bergmite
entry: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Bergmite
entry: They chill the air around them to -150 degrees Fahrenheit , freezing the water in the air into ice that they use as armor.

name: Bergmite
entry: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.

name: Bergmite
entry: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

name: Bergmite
entry: They live in mountainous regions of frigid cold. On rare occasions, they ride on the back of an Avalugg to cross seas and move to new habitats.

name: Bergmite
entry: Bergmite protects itself by coating its body in ice formed by frigid air of -148 degrees Fahrenheit . It fights with Frigibax whenever they meet.

name: Avalugg
entry: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

name: Avalugg
entry: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Avalugg
entry: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Avalugg
entry: At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.

name: Avalugg
entry: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.

name: Avalugg
entry: With its icy jaw, it swiftly plows across snowy fields and mountains, in search of nutritious vegetables people have stored in the snow.

name: Avalugg
entry: As Avalugg walks along with Bergmite on its back, it comes across pods of Cetitan . It lets them pass to avoid conflict.

name: Avalugg
entry: This Pokémon uses its massive icy body to flatten anything that gets in its way. When it's floating out on the ocean, it looks exactly like drift ice.

name: Avalugg
entry: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Noibat
entry: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Noibat
entry: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Noibat
entry: It flies around in search of fruit to eat. It uses ultrasonic waves to detect which fruits are ripe.

name: Noibat
entry: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.

name: Noibat
entry: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat's ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

name: Noibat
entry: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

name: Noibat
entry: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

name: Noibat
entry: Noibat can change the frequency of its sound waves at will, and it generates ultrasonic waves of up to 200,000 hertz.

name: Noivern
entry: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

name: Noivern
entry: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Noivern
entry: This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks anything it sees with ultrasonic waves that can crush boulders.

name: Noivern
entry: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

name: Noivern
entry: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Noivern
entry: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Noivern
entry: Ultrasonic waves emitted by a Noivern can pulverize a large boulder. This Pokémon has a cruel disposition.

name: Noivern
entry: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

name: Xerneas
entry: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Xerneas
entry: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Yveltal
entry: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Yveltal
entry: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: Yveltal
entry: It's said that when its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Zygarde
entry: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

name: Zygarde
entry: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: Zygarde
entry: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.

name: Zygarde
entry: This is Zygarde's form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.

name: Zygarde
entry: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

name: Zygarde
entry: This is Zygarde's form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.

name: Zygarde
entry: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Zygarde
entry: Its sharp fangs make short work of finishing off its enemies, but it's unable to maintain this body indefinitely. After a period of time, it falls apart.

name: Zygarde
entry: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph .

name: Zygarde
entry: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

name: Zygarde
entry: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

name: Zygarde
entry: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

name: Zygarde
entry: This is Zygarde's 100% form. It has enough power to overwhelm even Xerneas or Yveltal.

name: Zygarde
entry: This is Zygarde's perfected form. From the orifice on its chest, it radiates high-powered energy that eliminates everything.

name: Zygarde
entry: In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.

name: Diancie
entry: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Diancie
entry: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Diancie
entry: This Pokémon is also known as the Royal Pink Princess. The dazzling, sparkling diamond on its forehead is a whopping 2,000 carats.

name: Diancie
entry: Diancie is a spontaneous mutation of Carbink. Its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Hoopa
entry: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Hoopa
entry: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

name: Hoopa
entry: This is Hoopa's true form, in which it has regained its sealed powers. The hole in its chest is said to connect to another dimension.

name: Hoopa
entry: It uses loops to gather things it likes and take them to its secret home. It also teleports through a loop.

name: Volcanion
entry: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Volcanion
entry: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Rowlet
entry: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

name: Rowlet
entry: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Rowlet
entry: Silently it glides, drawing near its targets. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.

name: Rowlet
entry: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Rowlet
entry: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Rowlet
entry: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks. *

name: Rowlet
entry: During the day, it builds up energy via photosynthesis. At night, it flies silently through the sky, on the prowl for prey. *

name: Rowlet
entry: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to nestle into its Trainer’s bag or the front of their jacket.

name: Rowlet
entry: Silently it glides, streaking toward its targets to get close to them. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.

name: Dartrix
entry: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

name: Dartrix
entry: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: Dartrix
entry: It throws sharp feathers called blade quills at enemies or prey. It seldom misses.

name: Dartrix
entry: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

name: Dartrix
entry: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Dartrix
entry: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills. *

name: Dartrix
entry: It never slacks when it comes to the task of cleaning its feathers. Thorough preening keeps it looking spiffy and its blade quills nice and sharp. *

name: Dartrix
entry: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Decidueye
entry: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.

name: Decidueye
entry: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards .

name: Decidueye
entry: Although basically cool and cautious, when it's caught by surprise, it's seized by panic.

name: Decidueye
entry: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

name: Decidueye
entry: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui 's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Decidueye
entry: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss. *

name: Decidueye
entry: In a tenth of a second, it can nock and fire an arrow quill, piercing an opponent's weak point before they notice what's happening. *

name: Decidueye
entry: It nocks its arrow quills and looses them at opponents. When it needs to hit, it pulls the vines on its hood to narrow its view and focus.

name: Decidueye
entry: It cunningly conceals arrow quills in its wings. It launches these quills with such precision that they can pierce a pebble at over a hundred yards.

name: Litten
entry: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

name: Litten
entry: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Litten
entry: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

name: Litten
entry: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Litten
entry: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful. *

name: Litten
entry: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves. *

name: Litten
entry: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
entry: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

name: Torracat
entry: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: Torracat
entry: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

name: Torracat
entry: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

name: Torracat
entry: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat's fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter. *

name: Torracat
entry: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat's neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual. *

name: Torracat
entry: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Torracat
entry: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever fire spews out.

name: Incineroar
entry: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

name: Incineroar
entry: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Incineroar
entry: After hurling ferocious punches and flinging furious kicks, it finishes opponents off by spewing fire from around its navel.

name: Incineroar
entry: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

name: Incineroar
entry: Incineroar's rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well. *

name: Incineroar
entry: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles. The temperature of the flames that issue from its navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit . *

name: Popplio
entry: Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons to jump higher. It's quite the acrobatic fighter!

name: Popplio
entry: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Popplio
entry: This Pokémon can control water bubbles. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

name: Popplio
entry: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Popplio
entry: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills. *

name: Popplio
entry: It creates special bouncy balloons to send at its opponents. When the balloons pop, the sheer force of their bursting is what deals damage. *

name: Popplio
entry: This Pokémon can control balloons made of water. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big balloons.

name: Brionne
entry: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.

name: Brionne
entry: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

name: Brionne
entry: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

name: Brionne
entry: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn't know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Brionne
entry: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that's leading them. *

name: Brionne
entry: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it's busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes. *

name: Brionne
entry: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try to help.

name: Brionne
entry: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, then briskly bombards its enemies.

name: Primarina
entry: Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony in song.

name: Primarina
entry: It controls its water balloons with song . The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

name: Primarina
entry: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.

name: Primarina
entry: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

name: Primarina
entry: For Primarina, every battle's a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience. *

name: Primarina
entry: With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that sound like beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves to control its water balloons. *

name: Primarina
entry: Also known as a songstress, it is a sight to behold on moonlit nights when it sings in front of the colony it leads.

name: Pikipek
entry: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Pikipek
entry: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

name: Pikipek
entry: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

name: Pikipek
entry: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

name: Pikipek
entry: Pikipek has strong muscles in its neck, so it won’t hurt itself even if it violently shakes its head.

name: Pikipek
entry: Using its beak to strike 16 times per second, it opens holes in even the hardest of trees.

name: Trumbeak
entry: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Trumbeak
entry: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

name: Trumbeak
entry: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

name: Trumbeak
entry: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.

name: Trumbeak
entry: When it encounters foes, it launches the many seeds stored in its beak in a radial burst.

name: Trumbeak
entry: It flies around using a hundred different cries in various ways to declare its territory to others.

name: Toucannon
entry: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Toucannon
entry: When it battles, its beak heats up . The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit , causing severe burns when it hits.

name: Toucannon
