entry: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

name: Toucannon
entry: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

name: Toucannon
entry: Pairs of Toucannon are considered symbols of companionship, as these Pokémon will raise the temperature of their beaks to warm each other.

name: Toucannon
entry: The compressed gas in Toucannon’s beak launches seeds with such force that they can shatter large boulders.

name: Yungoos
entry: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Yungoos
entry: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

name: Yungoos
entry: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

name: Yungoos
entry: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

name: Yungoos
entry: It spends its waking hours searching for food. When Yungoos is hungry, its ferocity gains a certain edge.

name: Yungoos
entry: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

name: Gumshoos
entry: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Gumshoos
entry: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

name: Gumshoos
entry: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal , it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.

name: Gumshoos
entry: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.

name: Gumshoos
entry: Gumshoos specializes in relentlessly tracking down prey. The simple-minded Skwovet doesn't seem to provide Gumshoos enough challenge.

name: Gumshoos
entry: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

name: Grubbin
entry: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.

name: Grubbin
entry: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

name: Grubbin
entry: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

name: Grubbin
entry: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

name: Grubbin
entry: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Grubbin
entry: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee , may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Grubbin
entry: It spits sticky thread and winds them around branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree in a pendulum-like motion.

name: Grubbin
entry: Grubbin normally live underground, but if they get unearthed by Hoothoot, they may be found gathered around electric Pokémon.

name: Charjabug
entry: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.

name: Charjabug
entry: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

name: Charjabug
entry: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

name: Charjabug
entry: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

name: Charjabug
entry: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Charjabug
entry: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Charjabug
entry: As it digests fallen leaves, it generates and stores electricity, which it can discharge from the tips of its jaws.

name: Charjabug
entry: Protected by a sturdy shell, Charjabug eats large quantities of fresh and decomposing leaf litter in order to evolve.

name: Vikavolt
entry: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.

name: Vikavolt
entry: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

name: Vikavolt
entry: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

name: Vikavolt
entry: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

name: Vikavolt
entry: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Vikavolt
entry: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Vikavolt
entry: When carrying a Charjabug , Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Vikavolt
entry: Displaying exceptional mobility, it weaves between trees and shoots down bird Pokémon with its electromagnetic beams.

name: Crabrawler
entry: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

name: Crabrawler
entry: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: Crabrawler
entry: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

name: Crabrawler
entry: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

name: Crabrawler
entry: If it loses its pincers, they'll quickly regrow. The pincers are popular ingredients in paella since their shells produce a tasty soup stock.

name: Crabrawler
entry: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

name: Crabominable
entry: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Crabominable
entry: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

name: Crabominable
entry: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

name: Crabominable
entry: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

name: Crabominable
entry: Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon's movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles from its mouth to immobilize its opponents.

name: Crabominable
entry: The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Some dancers use its graceful, elegant dancing as inspiration.

name: Oricorio
entry: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.

name: Oricorio
entry: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

name: Oricorio
entry: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

name: Oricorio
entry: It lifts its opponents' spirits with its cheerful dance moves. When they let their guard down, it electrocutes them with a jolt.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio has drunk bright yellow nectar. When it sees someone looking glum, it will try to cheer them up with a dance.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. Its enemies' hearts melt at the sight of its gently swaying hips.

name: Oricorio
entry: It relaxes its opponents with its elegant dancing. When they let their guard down, it showers them with psychic energy.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It gets so caught up in its dancing that it sometimes doesn't hear its Trainer's orders.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

name: Oricorio
entry: It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing. From their malice, it draws power with which to curse its enemies.

name: Oricorio
entry: It charms its opponents with its refined dancing. When they let their guard down, it places a curse on them that will bring on their demise.

name: Oricorio
entry: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

name: Oricorio
entry: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

name: Oricorio
entry: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Oricorio
entry: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Oricorio
entry: The energetic, cheerful dance of these Oricorio is popular with children, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

name: Oricorio
entry: The airy dance of these Oricorio is popular as a means of maintaining good health, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

name: Oricorio
entry: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

name: Oricorio
entry: This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the spirits of the dead.

name: Cutiefly
entry: Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes' movements and make fools of them.

name: Cutiefly
entry: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Cutiefly
entry: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

name: Cutiefly
entry: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

name: Cutiefly
entry: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Cutiefly
entry: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

name: Cutiefly
entry: Cutiefly sucks up pollen and nectar with its long proboscis. It stores any pollen it doesn't finish eating in its fur.

name: Cutiefly
entry: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

name: Ribombee
entry: It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.

name: Ribombee
entry: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: Ribombee
entry: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

name: Ribombee
entry: Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.

name: Ribombee
entry: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Ribombee
entry: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Ribombee
entry: Pollen puffs created by skilled Ribombee can relieve fatigue, making the puffs a popular commodity.

name: Ribombee
entry: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

name: Rockruff
entry: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Rockruff
entry: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: Rockruff
entry: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

name: Rockruff
entry: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

name: Rockruff
entry: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Rockruff
entry: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

name: Rockruff
entry: This Pokémon travels in a pack with others until it grows up. When its mood turns sour, it starts striking the ground with the rocks on its neck.

name: Rockruff
entry: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Lycanroc
entry: This strange form is the result of its evolving at dusk. It's very rare in Alola.

name: Lycanroc
entry: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: Lycanroc
entry: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.

name: Lycanroc
entry: The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.

name: Lycanroc
entry: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

name: Lycanroc
entry: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

name: Lycanroc
entry: It goads its enemies into attacking, withstands the hits, and in return, delivers a headbutt, crushing their bones with its rocky mane.

name: Lycanroc
entry: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

name: Lycanroc
entry: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

name: Lycanroc
entry: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

name: Lycanroc
entry: These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious qualities. Their temperamental nature makes them a difficult species to raise.

name: Lycanroc
entry: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.

name: Lycanroc
entry: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.

name: Lycanroc
entry: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

name: Lycanroc
entry: It's invigorated by powerful opponents–the stronger the better. A full-force headbutt from one of these Lycanroc can shatter giant boulders.

name: Lycanroc
entry: This form of Lycanroc is normally calm and quiet. Once a battle begins, however, this Pokémon displays a ferocious fighting spirit.

name: Lycanroc
entry: These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious qualities. It's said that this form of Lycanroc is the most troublesome to raise.

name: Lycanroc
entry: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

name: Lycanroc
entry: It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane.

name: Lycanroc
entry: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

name: Lycanroc
entry: This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.

name: Lycanroc
entry: Normally this Pokémon doesn’t even bark, but once it enters battle, it will relentlessly drive the opponent into a corner.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: Called “demon of the sea” by some, when Wishiwashi are injured in battle and their numbers dwindle, they become a regular school.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: It's awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: They're weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: Weak Wishiwashi school together to concentrate their power. Their united force makes them the demon of the sea, feared near and far.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: At their appearance, even Gyarados will flee. When they team up to use Water Gun , its power exceeds that of Hydro Pump .

name: Wishiwashi
entry: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name “demon of the sea.”

name: Wishiwashi
entry: When facing tough opponents, they get into formation. But if they get wounded in battle, they'll scatter and become solitary again.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Wishiwashi
entry: On their own, they're very weak. But when Wishiwashi pool their power together in a school, they become a demon of the sea.

name: Mareanie
entry: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they're cut off. After a good night's sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.

name: Mareanie
entry: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: Mareanie
entry: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola 's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

name: Mareanie
entry: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

name: Mareanie
entry: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

name: Mareanie
entry: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Mareanie
entry: It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter, astringent flavor—they're not suitable as food.

name: Mareanie
entry: This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for food. It often gets electric shocks from broken Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.

name: Toxapex
entry: With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn't affect Toxapex in there, so it's very comfortable.

name: Toxapex
entry: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

name: Toxapex
entry: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

name: Toxapex
entry: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

name: Toxapex
entry: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

name: Toxapex
entry: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Toxapex
entry: Toxapex gets into fierce battles with Bruxish over areas where warm ocean currents flow, but the odds are always against it.

name: Toxapex
entry: This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.

name: Mudbray
entry: Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be loaded with 50 times its own body weight and will be totally fine.

name: Mudbray
entry: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: Mudbray
entry: It has a stubborn, individualistic disposition. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire all form part of its daily routine.

name: Mudbray
entry: It loves playing in the mud. If it isn't showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.

name: Mudbray
entry: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

name: Mudbray
entry: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

name: Mudbray
entry: Though a slow walker, Mudbray is plenty strong. Its pace doesn't change even when it's loaded with 50 times its own body weight.

name: Mudbray
entry: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won’t dry out even if it’s exposed to the sun for a long time.

name: Mudsdale
entry: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.

name: Mudsdale
entry: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Mudsdale
entry: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.

name: Mudsdale
entry: It remains calm and unmoving no matter the situation. It mixes dirt with the saliva in its mouth to make a special kind of mud.

name: Mudsdale
entry: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

name: Mudsdale
entry: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

name: Mudsdale
entry: Its legs are fortified with mud and harder than stone, and they can reduce a large truck to scrap with one kick.

name: Mudsdale
entry: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

name: Dewpider
entry: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.

name: Dewpider
entry: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Dewpider
entry: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

name: Dewpider
entry: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

name: Dewpider
entry: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Dewpider
entry: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Dewpider
entry: It supports the water bubble that envelops its head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.

name: Dewpider
entry: Dewpider uses sticky threads to create the water bubble that covers its head, so the bubble very rarely bursts.

name: Araquanid
entry: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn't watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!

name: Araquanid
entry: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Araquanid
entry: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

name: Araquanid
entry: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
entry: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider , putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Araquanid
entry: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Araquanid
entry: It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles will get torn apart by Araquanid’s gnashing jaws.

name: Araquanid
entry: A caring Pokémon, Araquanid carries Dewpider around inside its water bubble to protect them as it walks. It protects its food in its bubble too.

name: Fomantis
entry: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

name: Fomantis
entry: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

name: Fomantis
entry: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

name: Fomantis
entry: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

name: Fomantis
entry: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

name: Fomantis
entry: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokémon to gather around it.

name: Fomantis
entry: Many Trainers give their Fomantis their own flowerpots so they can sunbathe in peace and quiet.

name: Fomantis
entry: Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.

name: Lurantis
entry: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

name: Lurantis
entry: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

name: Lurantis
entry: It fires beams from its sickle-shaped petals. These beams are powerful enough to cleave through thick metal plates.

name: Lurantis
entry: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

name: Lurantis
entry: The petals on this Pokémon's arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

name: Lurantis
entry: This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.

name: Lurantis
entry: A lot of time and effort is required to maintain the vivid colors of its petals. This Pokémon puts its Trainer's attentiveness to the test.

name: Lurantis
entry: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

name: Morelull
entry: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.

name: Morelull
entry: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Morelull
entry: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

name: Morelull
entry: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

name: Morelull
entry: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

name: Morelull
entry: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic
entry: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect , the entire area gets completely coated in spores!

name: Shiinotic
entry: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: Shiinotic
entry: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

name: Shiinotic
entry: It puts its prey to sleep and siphons off their vitality through the tip of its arms. If one of its kind is weakened, it helps by sending it vitality.

name: Shiinotic
entry: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don't go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

name: Shiinotic
entry: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Salandit
entry: It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn't deal well with Spinda , since it's always reeling.

name: Salandit
entry: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Salandit
entry: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

name: Salandit
entry: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Salandit
entry: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salandit
entry: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

name: Salandit
entry: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.

name: Salandit
entry: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
entry: It punishes Salandit that couldn't bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.

name: Salazzle
entry: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: Salazzle
entry: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Salazzle
entry: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

name: Salazzle
entry: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Salazzle
entry: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

name: Salazzle
entry: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other's group.

name: Salazzle
entry: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Stufful
entry: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.

name: Stufful
entry: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Stufful
entry: A touch from anyone except a known friend sends it into a surging frenzy. It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

name: Stufful
entry: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Stufful
entry: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Stufful
entry: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
entry: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.

name: Bewear
entry: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Bewear
entry: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

name: Bewear
entry: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

name: Bewear
entry: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Bewear
entry: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Bounsweet
entry: It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It's usually a fruitless attempt.

name: Bounsweet
entry: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

name: Bounsweet
entry: Although it's too sugary for human consumption, Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

name: Bounsweet
entry: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

name: Bounsweet
entry: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Bounsweet
entry: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

name: Bounsweet
entry: A Greedent drawn in by the sweet scent of these Pokémon will tuck the Bounsweet in among the berries in its tail and carry them all away.

name: Bounsweet
entry: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
entry: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. They're quite painful when they smack you!

name: Steenee
entry: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

name: Steenee
entry: This Pokémon is always bouncing around energetically. Other Pokémon are attracted by its lively appearance and pleasant aroma.

name: Steenee
entry: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

name: Steenee
entry: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

name: Steenee
entry: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

name: Steenee
entry: Steenee bounces energetically through forests. If the rind that peels off its body is pulverized, it can be used to treat stomach pains.

name: Steenee
entry: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
entry: A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.

name: Tsareena
entry: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

name: Tsareena
entry: A Pokémon known for the beauty of its well-shaped legs, it sometimes appears as a mascot in advertisements for beauty salons.

name: Tsareena
entry: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

name: Tsareena
entry: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.

name: Tsareena
entry: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

name: Tsareena
entry: This Pokémon launches fierce yet elegant kicks with its long, slender legs. It views Quaquaval as its rival.

name: Tsareena
entry: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Comfey
entry: It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.

name: Comfey
entry: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

name: Comfey
entry: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.

name: Comfey
entry: It stretches sticky vines out from its head and picks flowers to adorn itself with. When it doesn't have any flowers, it feels uneasy.

name: Comfey
entry: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

name: Comfey
entry: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Comfey
entry: It prefers areas with lots of flowers. A Comfey adorned with flowers is a happy Comfey, and the flowers gain healing effects.

name: Comfey
entry: It uses its vine to pick flowers. The flowers that Comfey attaches to itself develop healing properties.

name: Oranguru
entry: Oranguru don't get along with each other, so they're always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.

name: Oranguru
entry: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

name: Oranguru
entry: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking .

name: Oranguru
entry: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Oranguru
entry: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Oranguru
entry: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

name: Oranguru
entry: This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages.

name: Oranguru
entry: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

name: Passimian
entry: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.

name: Passimian
entry: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: Passimian
entry: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

name: Passimian
entry: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

name: Passimian
entry: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Passimian
entry: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

name: Passimian
entry: The boss chooses 10 members of the group to go out hunting. The hunting party will evenly split the food they find with the rest of the group.

name: Passimian
entry: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won’t obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.

name: Wimpod
entry: An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, Wimpod will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if anything comes near it.

name: Wimpod
entry: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Wimpod
entry: Its habitat varies from beaches to seabeds. A natural scavenger, it will gleefully chow down on anything edible, no matter how rotten.

name: Wimpod
entry: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

name: Wimpod
entry: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.

name: Wimpod
entry: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
entry: Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod .

name: Golisopod
entry: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

name: Golisopod
entry: It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.

name: Golisopod
entry: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

name: Golisopod
entry: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner's meal.

name: Golisopod
entry: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Sandygast
entry: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

name: Sandygast
entry: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: Sandygast
entry: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

name: Sandygast
entry: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

name: Sandygast
entry: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

name: Sandygast
entry: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

name: Sandygast
entry: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they're blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

name: Sandygast
entry: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
entry: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

name: Palossand
entry: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

name: Palossand
entry: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

name: Palossand
entry: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

name: Palossand
entry: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can't maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

name: Palossand
entry: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

name: Palossand
entry: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.

name: Palossand
entry: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

name: Pyukumuku
entry: Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you'll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!

name: Pyukumuku
entry: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

name: Pyukumuku
entry: These Pokémon line the beaches. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!

name: Pyukumuku
entry: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

name: Pyukumuku
entry: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

name: Pyukumuku
entry: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Type: Null
entry: There's danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.

name: Type: Null
entry: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: Type: Null
entry: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its power.

name: Type: Null
entry: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Type: Null
entry: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth . The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Type: Null
entry: Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research notes led to a new instance of this Pokémon being created in the Galar region.

name: Silvally
entry: Its capacity to change types unleashed, it shines silver due to the energy springing forth from within.

name: Silvally
entry: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type , a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

name: Silvally
entry: Although its name was Type: Null at first, the boy who evolved it into this form gave it the name by which it is now known.

name: Silvally
entry: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Silvally
entry: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer , its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.

name: Silvally
entry: It destroyed its own control mask. It has become capable of changing its type by equipping special memories.

name: Silvally
entry: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories , this Pokémon can adapt its type to confound its enemies.

name: Silvally
entry: Having been awakened successfully, it can change its type and battle—just like a certain Pokémon depicted in legends .

name: Silvally
entry: It has the ability to change its type based on the memory it's holding. This is its <Type> -type form.

name: Silvally
entry: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.

name: Silvally
entry: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Silvally
entry: Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to the <Type> type to match the memory it has equipped.

name: Minior
entry: This Pokémon has no Pokédex entries in Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee! .

name: Minior
entry: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

name: Minior
entry: Strong impacts can knock it out of its shell. This Pokémon was born from mutated nanoparticles.

name: Minior
entry: It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokémon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.

name: Minior
entry: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

name: Minior
entry: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

name: Minior
entry: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

name: Minior
entry: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

name: Minior
entry: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.

name: Minior
entry: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

name: Minior
entry: This Pokémon is born in the ozone layer. It falls to the ground once the outer shell enclosing its core grows heavy.

name: Minior
entry: It will react when touched or called to, but it’s unknown whether such responses indicate consciousness.

name: Minior
entry: Minior that fall to the ground try to return to space, but their wish will not come true—all they can do is fade away.

name: Minior
entry: Violet Core Minior in the Alola Pokédex

name: Komala
entry: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Komala
entry: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

name: Komala
entry: The log it holds was given to it by its parents at birth. It has also been known to cling to the arm of a friendly Trainer.

name: Komala
entry: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

name: Komala
entry: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala's drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

name: Komala
entry: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

name: Turtonator
entry: Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.

name: Turtonator
entry: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck . The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Turtonator
entry: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

name: Turtonator
entry: It lives in volcanoes and eats sulfur and other minerals. Materials from the food it eats form the basis of its explosive shell.

name: Turtonator
entry: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Turtonator
entry: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Togedemaru
entry: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!

name: Togedemaru
entry: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: Togedemaru
entry: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

name: Togedemaru
entry: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

name: Togedemaru
entry: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Togedemaru
entry: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Mimikyu
entry: Sad that its true identity may be exposed, Mimikyu will mercilessly seek revenge on any opponent that breaks its neck.

name: Mimikyu
entry: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: Mimikyu
entry: A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.

name: Mimikyu
entry: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

name: Mimikyu
entry: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.

name: Mimikyu
entry: After going to all the effort of disguising itself, its neck was broken. Whatever is inside is probably unharmed, but it's still feeling sad.

name: Mimikyu
entry: If its neck is broken or its rag torn during an attack, it works through the night to patch it.

name: Mimikyu
entry: It stands in front of a mirror, trying to fix its broken neck as if its life depended on it. It has a hard time getting it right, so it's crying inside.

name: Mimikyu
entry: Its disguise made from an old rag allowed it to avoid an attack, but the impact broke the neck of the disguise. Now everyone knows it's a Mimikyu.

name: Mimikyu
entry: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

name: Mimikyu
entry: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu's old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Mimikyu
entry: There will be no forgiveness for any who reveal that it was pretending to be Pikachu. It will bring the culprit down, even at the cost of its own life.

name: Mimikyu
entry: It has taken damage and can no longer hold the head of its cloth disguise upright. For as long as it lives, Mimikyu will never forget its attacker.

name: Mimikyu
entry: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Mimikyu
entry: Mimikyu was only recently identified as a Pokémon. Previously, people thought it was just a ghost wearing a cloth.

name: Mimikyu
entry: Even as it struggles beneath the cloth to repair the broken neck of its disguise, Mimikyu keeps up its impersonation of Pikachu.

name: Bruxish
entry: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie 's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

name: Bruxish
entry: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: Bruxish
entry: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder 's shell is no match for it.

name: Bruxish
entry: It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.

name: Bruxish
entry: When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly.

name: Bruxish
entry: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

name: Drampa
entry: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they're in danger, so their moms don't have to worry.

name: Drampa
entry: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Drampa
entry: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

name: Drampa
entry: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.

name: Drampa
entry: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Drampa
entry: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Drampa
entry: Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.

name: Dhelmise
entry: Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp .

name: Dhelmise
entry: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

name: Dhelmise
entry: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

name: Dhelmise
entry: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord .

name: Dhelmise
entry: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

name: Dhelmise
entry: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: It will never show an enemy its back in battle. Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant disposition and made it one of their own.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. Jangmo-o grow little by little as they battle one another.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that's become as hard as metal.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: They communicate with their allies using the sounds their scales make when struck. A group of these Pokémon causes quite a racket.

name: Jangmo-o
entry: The scale atop its head is useful for both offense and defense. It bravely stands and faces its foes rather than turning tail, even if its foes are strong.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they're a popular item.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they're regrown.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.

name: Hakamo-o
entry: It gets into fistfights so intense that the scales on its arms peel off. Bare arms are a sign of valiance.

name: Kommo-o
entry: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.

name: Kommo-o
entry: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

name: Kommo-o
entry: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.

name: Kommo-o
entry: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

name: Kommo-o
entry: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

name: Kommo-o
entry: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

name: Kommo-o
entry: It bashes its scales to test its opponents' mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

name: Kommo-o
entry: It lets its arm hang, and then "quick as a flash" swings upward to land its specialty punch and send the opponent flying high into the sky.

name: Tapu Koko
entry: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

name: Tapu Koko
entry: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

name: Tapu Koko
entry: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

name: Tapu Koko
entry: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Tapu Lele
entry: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Tapu Lele
entry: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

name: Tapu Lele
entry: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

name: Tapu Lele
entry: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Tapu Bulu
entry: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula'ula controls plants.

name: Tapu Bulu
entry: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

name: Tapu Bulu
entry: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.

name: Tapu Bulu
entry: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Tapu Fini
entry: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

name: Tapu Fini
entry: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

name: Tapu Fini
entry: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

name: Tapu Fini
entry: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Cosmog
entry: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

name: Cosmog
entry: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Cosmog
entry: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

name: Cosmog
entry: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Cosmog
entry: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away. *

name: Cosmog
entry: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away. *

name: Cosmoem
entry: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

name: Cosmoem
entry: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

name: Cosmoem
entry: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

name: Cosmoem
entry: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.

name: Cosmoem
entry: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution. *

name: Cosmoem
entry: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material. *

name: Solgaleo
entry: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name “the beast that devours the sun.”

name: Solgaleo
entry: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

name: Solgaleo
entry: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog . At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

name: Solgaleo
entry: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

name: Solgaleo
entry: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it. *

name: Solgaleo
entry: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world. *

name: Lunala
entry: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

name: Lunala
entry: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog . When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: Lunala
entry: Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

name: Lunala
entry: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name “the beast that calls the moon.”

name: Lunala
entry: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky. *

name: Lunala
entry: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy. *

name: Nihilego
entry: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

name: Nihilego
entry: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

name: Nihilego
entry: One of the Ultra Beasts. It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

name: Nihilego
entry: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Buzzwole
entry: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Buzzwole
entry: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

name: Buzzwole
entry: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

name: Buzzwole
entry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Pheromosa
entry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Pheromosa
entry: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

name: Pheromosa
entry: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

name: Pheromosa
entry: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

name: Xurkitree
entry: They've been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

name: Xurkitree
entry: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

name: Xurkitree
entry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

name: Xurkitree
entry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Celesteela
entry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Celesteela
entry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

name: Celesteela
entry: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

name: Celesteela
entry: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.

name: Kartana
entry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Kartana
entry: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

name: Kartana
entry: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

name: Kartana
entry: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Guzzlord
entry: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Guzzlord
entry: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.

name: Guzzlord
entry: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

name: Guzzlord
entry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Necrozma
entry: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

name: Necrozma
entry: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts , this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

name: Necrozma
entry: Light is apparently the source of its energy. It has an extraordinarily vicious disposition and is constantly firing off laser beams .

name: Necrozma
entry: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

name: Necrozma
entry: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.

name: Necrozma
entry: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo . It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

name: Necrozma
entry: This is Necrozma's form while it's absorbing the power of Solgaleo , making it extremely ferocious and impossible to control.

name: Necrozma
entry: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

name: Necrozma
entry: This is its form while it's devouring the light of Lunala . It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.

name: Necrozma
entry: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

name: Necrozma
entry: When Necrozma latches on to Lunala , it becomes vicious, seeing enemies everywhere it looks. It will burn the world with lasers. *

name: Necrozma
entry: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken. *

name: Necrozma
entry: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces. *

name: Necrozma
entry: When it dominates Solgaleo , it takes on this form. It's a vicious Pokémon, mangling prey with its many claws—including those on its back. *

name: Necrozma
entry: Necrozma has attached itself to Solgaleo . It siphons away its host's limitless energy, exploiting that energy to fuel a rampage. *

name: Necrozma
entry: Necrozma has subjugated Lunala entirely, forcing the unfortunate Pokémon to emit its light energy for Necrozma to consume. *

name: Magearna
entry: It functions thanks to its artificial soul. The vivid decoration is proof that it was presented as a gift to royalty.

name: Magearna
entry: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: Magearna
entry: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

name: Magearna
entry: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Magearna
entry: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Magearna
entry: This beautiful form reflects Magearna's appearance when first presented to a king's daughter 500 years ago.

name: Magearna
entry: This gorgeous Magearna looks as it did at the time of its invention. Its luxurious decoration pleased the king's daughter.

name: Magearna
entry: This is its form from almost 500 years ago. Its body is nothing more than a container—its artificial heart is the actual life-form.

name: Marshadow
entry: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

name: Marshadow
entry: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

name: Marshadow
entry: It lurks in the shadows of others, copying their movements and powers. This Pokémon is craven and cowering.

name: Marshadow
entry: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

name: Marshadow
entry: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time. *

name: Marshadow
entry: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques. *

name: Poipole
entry: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

name: Poipole
entry: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Naganadel
entry: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

name: Naganadel
entry: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Stakataka
entry: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: Stakataka
entry: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Blacephalon
entry: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Blacephalon
entry: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head . It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Zeraora
entry: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Zeraora
entry: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Zeraora
entry: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes. *

name: Zeraora
entry: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws. *

name: Meltan
entry: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Meltan
entry: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve. *

name: Meltan
entry: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy. *

name: Melmetal
entry: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Melmetal
entry: It can send electric beams streaking out from the hole in its belly. The beams' tremendous energy can vaporize an opponent in one shot. *

name: Melmetal
entry: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan. *

name: Melmetal
entry: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon. *

name: Melmetal
entry: In a distant land, there are legends about a cyclopean giant. In fact, the giant was a Melmetal that was flooded with Gigantamax energy. *

name: Grookey
