entry: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Grookey
entry: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Grookey
entry: As Grookey strikes everything in sight with its stick, it has more and more fun, and its rhythm becomes livelier.

name: Grookey
entry: The stick Grookey holds has grown harder and more flexible after soaking in the energy that emanates from inside Grookey’s body.

name: Thwackey
entry: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

name: Thwackey
entry: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Thwackey
entry: It becomes intensely focused while it drums out vigorous beats—so much so that sometimes it won’t listen to its Trainer’s commands.

name: Thwackey
entry: It skillfully uses its two sticks not only for drumming out rapid beats but also for pummeling opponents during battle.

name: Rillaboom
entry: Rillaboom has become one with its forest of drums and continues to lay down beats that shake all of Galar.

name: Rillaboom
entry: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Rillaboom
entry: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Rillaboom
entry: Gigantamax energy has caused Rillaboom's stump to grow into a drum set that resembles a forest.

name: Rillaboom
entry: When one Rillaboom challenges another who leads a troop, a drumming battle commences. The victor becomes the troop’s new boss.

name: Rillaboom
entry: Though it has a calm disposition, it won’t tolerate those who drum up discord. It strictly disciplines offenders until they learn their lesson.

name: Scorbunny
entry: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Scorbunny
entry: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Scorbunny
entry: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Scorbunny
entry: Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use the full extent of its power. That’s why it does warm-up exercises.

name: Raboot
entry: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Raboot
entry: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: Raboot
entry: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

name: Raboot
entry: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.

name: Cinderace
entry: Gigantamax energy can sometimes cause the diameter of this Pokémon's fireball to exceed 300 feet .

name: Cinderace
entry: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball . Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched .

name: Cinderace
entry: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Cinderace
entry: Infused with Cinderace's fighting spirit, the gigantic Pyro Ball never misses its targets and completely roasts opponents.

name: Cinderace
entry: Using a ball that it made out of flames, Cinderace blinds its opponents and keeps them at bay.

name: Cinderace
entry: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

name: Sobble
entry: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Sobble
entry: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Sobble
entry: It’s a very cautious Pokémon. When it has no choice but to battle, it hides itself before attacking.

name: Sobble
entry: It gets berries to eat by shooting them down with bullets of water it spurts from its mouth. Its aim is perfect.

name: Drizzile
entry: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Drizzile
entry: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Drizzile
entry: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it defends its home by laying traps.

name: Drizzile
entry: It extends its long, slimy tongue at blinding speeds and finishes off its prey with great skill.

name: Inteleon
entry: It has excellent sniping skills. Shooting a berry rolling along over nine miles away is a piece of cake for this Pokémon.

name: Inteleon
entry: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Inteleon
entry: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Inteleon
entry: Gigantamax Inteleon's Water Gun move fires at Mach 7. As the Pokémon takes aim, it uses the crest on its head to gauge wind and temperature.

name: Inteleon
entry: It may present itself as being well-mannered, but deep down, it still has a lazy side. It will slack off when its Trainer isn’t looking.

name: Inteleon
entry: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents—like their body heat—then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

name: Skwovet
entry: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

name: Skwovet
entry: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Skwovet
entry: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

name: Skwovet
entry: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

name: Greedent
entry: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Greedent
entry: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Greedent
entry: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Greedent
entry: If it spots a berry tree, it will immediately go to gather berries without a sideways glance—even if it’s in the middle of a battle.

name: Rookidee
entry: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Rookidee
entry: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Rookidee
entry: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee's wings, it'll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

name: Rookidee
entry: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

name: Corvisquire
entry: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

name: Corvisquire
entry: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corvisquire
entry: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

name: Corvisquire
entry: It’s said that the reason behind Corvisquire’s high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

name: Corviknight
entry: The eight feathers on its back are called blade birds, and they can launch off its body to attack foes independently.

name: Corviknight
entry: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Corviknight
entry: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

name: Corviknight
entry: Imbued with Gigantamax energy, its wings can whip up winds more forceful than any a hurricane could muster. The gusts blow everything away.

name: Corviknight
entry: Although its wings have partly turned to steel and become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies through the skies with ease.

name: Corviknight
entry: Corviknight can’t serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon’s natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

name: Blipbug
entry: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Blipbug
entry: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

name: Dottler
entry: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Dottler
entry: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: Orbeetle
entry: If it were to utilize every last bit of its power, it could control the minds of every living being in its vicinity.

name: Orbeetle
entry: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Orbeetle
entry: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Orbeetle
entry: Its brain has grown to a gargantuan size, as has the rest of its body. This Pokémon's intellect and psychic abilities are overpowering.

name: Nickit
entry: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Nickit
entry: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
entry: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Thievul
entry: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Gossifleur
entry: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Gossifleur
entry: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

name: Eldegoss
entry: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Eldegoss
entry: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

name: Wooloo
entry: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Wooloo
entry: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Dubwool
entry: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Dubwool
entry: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: Chewtle
entry: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Chewtle
entry: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Chewtle
entry: A popular game among children is to lift up sticks that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose Chewtle can hang on the longest.

name: Chewtle
entry: Its large front tooth is still growing in. When the tooth itches, this Pokémon will bite another Chewtle’s horn, and the two Pokémon will tussle.

name: Drednaw
entry: In the Galar region, there's a tale about this Pokémon chewing up a mountain and using the rubble to stop a flood.

name: Drednaw
entry: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Drednaw
entry: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Drednaw
entry: It responded to Gigantamax energy by becoming bipedal. First it comes crashing down on foes, and then it finishes them off with its massive jaws.

name: Drednaw
entry: Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck out and chomps down on them.

name: Drednaw
entry: Its massive, jagged teeth can crush a boulder in a single bite. This Pokémon has an extremely vicious disposition.

name: Yamper
entry: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Yamper
entry: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: Boltund
entry: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph .

name: Boltund
entry: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Rolycoly
entry: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Rolycoly
entry: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Rolycoly
entry: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon's body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

name: Rolycoly
entry: On sunny days, Rolycoly will come out onto grassy plains and roll around. Then it will eat the grass that gets tangled in its wheel-like leg.

name: Carkol
entry: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph . The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Carkol
entry: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Carkol
entry: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol's back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Carkol
entry: The temperature inside its body increases when it experiences strong emotions. It rolls around frantically while spewing flames.

name: Coalossal
entry: When Galar was hit by a harsh cold wave, this Pokémon served as a giant heating stove and saved many lives.

name: Coalossal
entry: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Coalossal
entry: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Coalossal
entry: Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax energy stoking the fire, this Pokémon's flame burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Coalossal
entry: It's gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit , it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

name: Coalossal
entry: To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from its smoldering back.

name: Applin
entry: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Applin
entry: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Applin
entry: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

name: Applin
entry: It grows by eating the flesh of an apple. Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen the apple’s skin and prevent it from rotting.

name: Flapple
entry: If it stretches its neck, the strong aroma of its nectar pours out. The scent is so sickeningly sweet that one whiff makes other Pokémon faint.

name: Flapple
entry: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Flapple
entry: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Flapple
entry: Under the influence of Gigantamax energy, it produces much more sweet nectar, and its shape has changed to resemble a giant apple.

name: Flapple
entry: It uses its own body fluid to repair its apple. Strong Flapple that have won many battles have apples that are clay colored all over.

name: Flapple
entry: It flutters around while seeking an opening in the opponent’s guard, then attacks by spitting acidic liquid strong enough to melt metal.

name: Appletun
entry: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon's nectar has thickened. The increased viscosity lets the nectar absorb more damage than before.

name: Appletun
entry: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Appletun
entry: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Appletun
entry: It blasts its opponents with massive amounts of sweet, sticky nectar, drowning them under the deluge.

name: Appletun
entry: When some Lechonk come along to lick the sweet nectar on Appletun's back, Appletun will spew sticky nectar at them to drive them away.

name: Appletun
entry: It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its sweet nectar.

name: Silicobra
entry: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Silicobra
entry: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

name: Silicobra
entry: Silicobra's large nostrils are specialized for spraying sand, so this Pokémon is not very good at telling apart different smells.

name: Silicobra
entry: Silicobra’s neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.

name: Sandaconda
entry: Sand swirls around its body with such speed and power that it could pulverize a skyscraper.

name: Sandaconda
entry: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: Sandaconda
entry: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Sandaconda
entry: Its sand pouch has grown to tremendous proportions. More than 1,000,000 tons of sand now swirl around its body.

name: Sandaconda
entry: The sand it spews contains sharp, pointy gravel, which is actually just sand that Sandaconda's saliva has hardened into irregular shapes.

name: Sandaconda
entry: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

name: Cramorant
entry: The half-swallowed Pikachu is so startled that it isn't struggling yet, but it's still looking for a chance to strike back.

name: Cramorant
entry: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Cramorant
entry: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Cramorant
entry: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

name: Cramorant
entry: The slightest shock is sometimes enough to get this Pokémon to spit out the Arrokuda lodged in its throat .

name: Cramorant
entry: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little, but it isn't really bothered.

name: Cramorant
entry: With a Pikachu stuck in its throat, Cramorant can use Pikachu's prickling electricity to give its opponents a shock.

name: Cramorant
entry: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They're at their most formidable when they're struggling to swallow overly large prey.

name: Cramorant
entry: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain. It focuses on battling instead.

name: Cramorant
entry: Cramorant is constantly on the hunt for food along riverbanks. It loves Arrokuda—when it finds them, it swallows them whole without a thought.

name: Cramorant
entry: Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda's frantic thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

name: Cramorant
entry: Its throat is clearly not wide enough to swallow a Pikachu, and yet Cramorant makes no move to release its catch.

name: Arrokuda
entry: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Arrokuda
entry: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: Arrokuda
entry: It takes down prey by charging into them with its hard, pointed jaw. But Arrokuda's eyesight is poor, so this tactic has a low success rate.

name: Arrokuda
entry: Arrokuda can swim quickly only in a straight line. The ones that become sluggish from overeating are the first to be targeted by flocks of Wattrel .

name: Barraskewda
entry: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Barraskewda
entry: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Barraskewda
entry: It swims at speeds of over 100 knots and battles fiercely with pods of Finizen over prey.

name: Barraskewda
entry: It spins its tail fins to leap from the water, then viciously bites down on Wingull flying close to the water’s surface.

name: Toxel
entry: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxel
entry: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxel
entry: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Toxel
entry: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel’s body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

name: Toxtricity
entry: Out of control after its own poison penetrated its brain, it tears across the land in a rampage, contaminating the earth with toxic sweat.

name: Toxtricity
entry: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Toxtricity
entry: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Toxtricity
entry: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

name: Toxtricity
entry: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

name: Toxtricity
entry: Its excessive electric energy is its weapon. This Pokémon can build up more electricity than any thundercloud.

name: Toxtricity
entry: As it gulps down stagnant water and generates electricity in its body, a sound like a rhythm played by a bass guitar reverberates all around.

name: Toxtricity
entry: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

name: Toxtricity
entry: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

name: Toxtricity
entry: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

name: Sizzlipede
entry: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Sizzlipede
entry: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
entry: The heat that comes off a Gigantamax Centiskorch may destabilize air currents. Sometimes it can even cause storms.

name: Centiskorch
entry: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit . It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Centiskorch
entry: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Centiskorch
entry: Gigantamax energy has evoked a rise in its body temperature, now reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit . Its heat waves incinerate its enemies.

name: Clobbopus
entry: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Clobbopus
entry: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Grapploct
entry: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Grapploct
entry: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Sinistea
entry: It absorbs the life-force of those who drink it. It waits patiently, but opportunities are fleeting—it tastes so bad that it gets spat out immediately.

name: Sinistea
entry: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Sinistea
entry: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Sinistea
entry: The swirl pattern in this Pokémon's body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

name: Sinistea
entry: This Sinistea lives in an antique teacup. As valuable as this Pokémon is, its awful taste remains unchanged.

name: Sinistea
entry: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

name: Sinistea
entry: Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it, and then it steals your vitality from within. It also tastes awful.

name: Sinistea
entry: Some fanatics will go to great pains to prepare the perfect tea and teacup, eagerly waiting for a Sinistea to come and possess their selections.

name: Polteageist
entry: When angered, it launches tea from its body at the offender's mouth. The tea causes strong chills if swallowed.

name: Polteageist
entry: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Polteageist
entry: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

name: Polteageist
entry: Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

name: Polteageist
entry: Though risky to drink, this Pokémon's tea tastes delicious. Gourmets who have no fear of danger drink Polteageist tea day after day.

name: Polteageist
entry: The tea that composes Polteageist’s body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

name: Polteageist
entry: These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots and pouring themselves into leftover tea.

name: Polteageist
entry: Apparently a Polteageist’s disposition is affected by the type of tea the Pokémon came from. What teapot it inhabits makes no difference.

name: Hatenna
entry: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hatenna
entry: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hatenna
entry: It senses the feelings of other living creatures. Be careful not to expose it to strong emotions for too long, or it will end up exhausted.

name: Hatenna
entry: Because the emotions of others constantly flow into its head, this Pokémon prefers environments where no other creatures live.

name: Hattrem
entry: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hattrem
entry: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hattrem
entry: The moment this Pokémon finds someone who's emitting strong emotions, it will pummel them senseless with its braids to silence them.

name: Hattrem
entry: To this Pokémon, strong emotions apparently feel like incredibly loud noises—even if the emotions are happy ones.

name: Hatterene
entry: Beams like lightning shoot down from its tentacles. It's known to some as the Raging Goddess.

name: Hatterene
entry: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Hatterene
entry: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Hatterene
entry: This Pokémon can read the emotions of creatures over 30 miles away. The minute it senses hostility, it goes on the attack.

name: Hatterene
entry: Beware of forests that show no signs of living creatures within. You may have wandered into Hatterene's territory.

name: Hatterene
entry: Hatterene knocks out those that intrude in its home forest by blasting them with a beam, then slashing with claws enhanced by psychic power.

name: Impidimp
entry: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Impidimp
entry: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Impidimp
entry: They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks on each other to polish their troublemaking skills.

name: Impidimp
entry: The reason this Pokémon causes trouble for those it feels close to is because Impidimp itself gets irritable if it can’t absorb negative emotions.

name: Morgrem
entry: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Morgrem
entry: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair .

name: Morgrem
entry: This Pokémon absorbs negative emotions and turns them into energy. It's popular with people who tend to think gloomy thoughts.

name: Morgrem
entry: Morgrem prefers dirty tactics, like ambushing, because it doesn’t have confidence in its brawn.

name: Grimmsnarl
entry: Gigantamax energy has caused more hair to sprout all over its body. With the added strength, it can jump over the world's tallest building.

name: Grimmsnarl
entry: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp .

name: Grimmsnarl
entry: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Grimmsnarl
entry: By transforming its leg hair, this Pokémon delivers power-packed drill kicks that can bore huge holes in Galar's terrain.

name: Grimmsnarl
entry: It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving into this splendid form, it hasn't given up on its petty misdeeds and pranks.

name: Grimmsnarl
entry: This Pokémon has complete control over its hair. Grimmsnarl normally keeps its hair wrapped around its body to support its muscles.

name: Obstagoon
entry: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Obstagoon
entry: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct .

name: Perrserker
entry: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Perrserker
entry: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Cursola
entry: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Cursola
entry: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

name: Sirfetch'd
entry: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

name: Sirfetch'd
entry: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Mr. Rime
entry: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Mr. Rime
entry: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Runerigus
entry: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

name: Runerigus
entry: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Milcery
entry: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Milcery
entry: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Milcery
entry: When attacked, it tackles its foe and covers them in cream. With its foe either blinded or astonished by deliciousness, Milcery flees.

name: Milcery
entry: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

name: Alcremie
entry: It launches swarms of missiles, each made of cream and loaded with 100,000 kilocalories. Get hit by one of these, and your head will swim.

name: Alcremie
entry: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Alcremie
entry: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Alcremie
entry: The moment it evolved, it took on a sweet and tart flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
entry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sweet and tart flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: The moment it evolved, it took on an aromatic flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
entry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream an aromatic flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: The moment it evolved, it took on a refreshing flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
entry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a refreshing flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: The moment it evolved, it took on a sour flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
entry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sour flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: The moment it evolved, it took on a salty flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
entry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a salty flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: The moment it evolved, it took on a mixed flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
entry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a mixed flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: The moment it evolved, it took on a bitter flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
entry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a bitter flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: The moment it evolved, it took on a complex flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
entry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a complex flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: Cream pours endlessly from this Pokémon's body. The cream stiffens when compressed by an impact. A harder impact results in harder cream.

name: Alcremie
entry: When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream accented with complex flavors.

name: Alcremie
entry: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

name: Alcremie
entry: Alcremie that have been cherished produce exquisite cream, so Trainers always raise them lovingly.

name: Alcremie
entry: Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved, giving it a sweet and tart flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream accented with sweet and tart flavors.

name: Alcremie
entry: Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved, giving it an aromatic flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream accented with an aromatic flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved, giving it a refreshing flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream accented with a refreshing flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved, giving it a sour flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream accented with a sour flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved, giving it a salty flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream accented with a salty flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved, giving it a mixed flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream accented with a mix of flavors.

name: Alcremie
entry: Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved, giving it a bitter flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: When attacked, it strikes back by throwing cream accented with a bitter flavor.

name: Alcremie
entry: Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved, giving it a complex flavor.

name: Falinks
entry: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Falinks
entry: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Falinks
entry: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.

name: Falinks
entry: The brass, which is the one that stands at the front and issues orders, is the strongest and smartest of the six.

name: Falinks
entry: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it's time to change formation.

name: Pincurchin
entry: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

name: Pincurchin
entry: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Pincurchin
entry: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

name: Pincurchin
entry: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

name: Snom
entry: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Snom
entry: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: Snom
entry: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Snom
entry: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

name: Frosmoth
entry: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Frosmoth
entry: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Frosmoth
entry: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

name: Frosmoth
entry: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

name: Stonjourner
entry: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Stonjourner
entry: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Stonjourner
entry: This Pokémon spends its life gazing at the setting sun. It strides leisurely across grassy plains on legs of rock that weigh over 400 pounds each.

name: Stonjourner
entry: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon’s habitat.

name: Eiscue
entry: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

name: Eiscue
entry: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: Eiscue
entry: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Eiscue
entry: The ice covering this Pokémon's face has shattered, revealing a slightly worried expression that many people are enamored with.

name: Eiscue
entry: Contrary to its looks, Eiscue is a poor swimmer. It creates ice balls at the tip of its single hair to lure prey in and fish them up.

name: Eiscue
entry: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

name: Eiscue
entry: If you lick the ice covering its face, you'll find it has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.

name: Eiscue
entry: The ice that was covering this Eiscue’s face has shattered. Eiscue emits cold air from the tip of its hair to protect its head, which is sensitive to heat.

name: Indeedee
entry: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

name: Indeedee
entry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

name: Indeedee
entry: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Indeedee
entry: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Indeedee
entry: In search of happy feelings—such as joy and gratitude—Indeedee bustles around, taking diligent care of people and other Pokémon.

name: Indeedee
entry: This Pokémon picks up on the positive emotions of other creatures via its horns and uses those emotions to fuel itself.

name: Indeedee
entry: This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer's side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

name: Indeedee
entry: It dislikes conflict. If a fight occurs in its territory, it uses psychic power to throw things at the combatants in an effort to drive them away.

name: Morpeko
entry: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

name: Morpeko
entry: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Morpeko
entry: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Morpeko
entry: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

name: Morpeko
entry: Hunger has disrupted this Pokémon's hormonal balance. The Electric-type energy stored in its cheek sacs has turned into Dark-type energy.

name: Morpeko
entry: Morpeko eats seeds constantly to keep its hunger at bay. If it's hungry for too long, it grows wild and brutish.

name: Morpeko
entry: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

name: Morpeko
entry: Even after using up all its dark energy, this violent ruffian will keep running riot until its hunger is appeased.

name: Cufant
entry: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Cufant
entry: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Cufant
entry: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

name: Cufant
entry: Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile and helps people with physical labor.

name: Copperajah
entry: After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed, its massive nose can utterly demolish large structures with a single smashing blow.

name: Copperajah
entry: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Copperajah
entry: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Copperajah
entry: So much power is packed within its trunk that if it were to unleash that power, the resulting blast could level mountains and change the landscape.

name: Copperajah
entry: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

name: Copperajah
entry: This Pokémon was brought to Paldea long ago by people from a faraway land. It’s so strong that it can easily pull an airplane.

name: Dracozolt
entry: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

name: Dracozolt
entry: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: Arctozolt
entry: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

name: Arctozolt
entry: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Dracovish
entry: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph , but this Pokémon can't breathe unless it's underwater.

name: Dracovish
entry: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Arctovish
entry: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

name: Arctovish
entry: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Duraludon
entry: The hardness of its cells is exceptional, even among Steel types. It also has a body structure that's resistant to earthquakes.

name: Duraludon
entry: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Duraludon
entry: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

name: Duraludon
entry: It's grown to resemble a skyscraper. Parts of its towering body glow due to a profusion of energy.

name: Duraludon
entry: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

name: Duraludon
entry: Duraludon’s body is comprised of a special metal that’s lightweight and scratch resistant. It’s also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

name: Dreepy
entry: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Dreepy
entry: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Dreepy
entry: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: Dreepy
entry: In the evening, groups of Dreepy will fly at high speeds over the ocean and poke at Pokémon in the water for fun.

name: Drakloak
entry: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

name: Drakloak
entry: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph . It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Drakloak
entry: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.

name: Drakloak
entry: This Pokémon flies around at over 120 miles per hour . If a Drakloak is defeated in a battle, its Dreepy will wander off without a second thought.

name: Dragapult
entry: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Dragapult
entry: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles .

name: Dragapult
entry: The fastest Dragapult of the group is always surrounded by Dreepy that want to fly at sonic speed.

name: Dragapult
entry: Dragapult can make its whole body transparent by clearing its mind and focusing. Even the Dreepy in Dragapult’s horns become invisible.

name: Zacian
entry: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Zacian
entry: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

name: Zacian
entry: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

name: Zacian
entry: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

name: Zamazenta
entry: Now that it's equipped with its shield, it can shrug off impressive blows, including the attacks of Dynamax Pokémon.

name: Zamazenta
entry: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

name: Zamazenta
entry: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Zamazenta
entry: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Eternatus
entry: Infinite amounts of energy pour from this Pokémon's enlarged core, warping the surrounding space-time.

name: Eternatus
entry: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region . This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Eternatus
entry: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

name: Eternatus
entry: As a result of Rose 's meddling, Eternatus absorbed all the energy in the Galar region. It's now in a state of power overload.

name: Kubfu
entry: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

name: Kubfu
entry: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

name: Urshifu
entry: All it takes is a glare from this Pokémon to take the lives of those with evil in their hearts—or so they say.

name: Urshifu
entry: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

name: Urshifu
entry: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Urshifu
entry: It's believed that this Pokémon modeled its fighting style on the flow of a river—sometimes rapid, sometimes calm.

name: Urshifu
entry: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

name: Urshifu
entry: People call it the embodiment of rage. It's said that this Pokémon's terrifying expression and shout will rid the world of malevolence.

name: Urshifu
entry: The energy released by this Pokémon's fists forms shock waves that can blow away Dynamax Pokémon in just one hit.

name: Urshifu
entry: As it waits for the right moment to unleash its Gigantamax power, this Pokémon maintains a perfect one-legged stance. It won't even twitch.

name: Zarude
entry: This Zarude's special strength stems from its love and care for an orphaned human child that the Pokémon has raised since the child's infancy.

name: Zarude
entry: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: Zarude
entry: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Zarude
entry: This Zarude left its pack to raise a human child . The cloth Zarude would wrap the child with has a comforting scent that calmed the child's crying.

name: Regieleki
entry: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar 's electricity.

name: Regieleki
entry: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

name: Regidrago
entry: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Regidrago
entry: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

name: Glastrier
entry: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

name: Glastrier
entry: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Spectrier
entry: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

name: Spectrier
entry: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Calyrex
entry: Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.

name: Calyrex
entry: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

name: Calyrex
entry: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

name: Calyrex
entry: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

name: Calyrex
entry: It's said that this Pokémon once moved a large forest—and all the Pokémon living there—to a new location overnight.

name: Calyrex
entry: It's said that Calyrex and a Pokémon that had bonded with it ran all across the Galar region to bring green to the wastelands.

name: Wyrdeer
entry: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Kleavor
entry: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Kleavor
entry: This Pokémon is a rough, crude, and violent sort. It swings around its large, heavy stone axes to finish off its prey.

name: Kleavor
entry: Parts of its body turned to stone when it evolved thanks to an extremely rare ore found in volcanic areas.

name: Ursaluna
entry: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Ursaluna
entry: This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.

name: Ursaluna
entry: It crossed the sea and drifted ashore in a new land . Surviving in this place led it to take on a unique appearance and gain special powers.

name: Basculegion
entry: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Basculegion
entry: It can afflict a target with terrifying illusions that are under its control. The deeper the sadness in its friends' souls, the paler Basculegion becomes.

name: Basculegion
entry: This Pokémon is cloaked in the souls of its comrades who perished during a punishing journey to the river of their birth.

name: Basculegion
entry: It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen friends.

name: Basculegion
entry: The souls of its comrades cloak its body and propel it effortlessly through even raging rapids.

name: Sneasler
entry: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Overqwil
entry: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Overqwil
entry: It’s ferocious and has a short temper. The ends of its spikes are barbed, and they can’t be easily removed once they’ve punctured something.

name: Overqwil
entry: Overqwil’s poisonous spikes will reflexively react even while Overqwil sleeps, stabbing any moving thing that approaches.

name: Enamorus
entry: A different guise from its feminine humanoid form. From the clouds, it descends upon those who treat any form of life with disrespect and metes out wrathful, ruthless punishment.

name: Enamorus
entry: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Sprigatito
entry: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Sprigatito
entry: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
entry: The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Floragato
entry: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Meowscarada
entry: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what's going on.

name: Meowscarada
entry: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining in its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Fuecoco
entry: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

name: Fuecoco
entry: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Crocalor
entry: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Crocalor
entry: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

name: Skeledirge
entry: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit .

name: Skeledirge
entry: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

name: Quaxly
entry: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Quaxly
entry: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Quaxwell
entry: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Quaxwell
entry: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Quaquaval
entry: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

name: Quaquaval
entry: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

name: Lechonk
entry: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

name: Lechonk
entry: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

name: Oinkologne
entry: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

name: Oinkologne
entry: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: Oinkologne
entry: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

name: Oinkologne
entry: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

name: Tarountula
entry: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Tarountula
entry: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther , this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

name: Spidops
entry: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

name: Spidops
entry: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Nymble
entry: It's highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

name: Nymble
entry: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Lokix
entry: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can't stay in this mode for long.

name: Lokix
entry: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Pawmi
entry: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmi
entry: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
entry: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmo
entry: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
entry: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Pawmot
entry: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Tandemaus
entry: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Tandemaus
entry: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: Maushold
entry: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

name: Maushold
entry: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

name: Maushold
entry: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Maushold
entry: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

name: Fidough
entry: The yeast in Fidough's breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Fidough
entry: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.

name: Dachsbun
entry: The surface of this Pokémon's skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

name: Dachsbun
entry: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Smoliv
entry: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Smoliv
entry: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
entry: It basks in the sun to its heart's content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

name: Dolliv
entry: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
entry: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Arboliva
entry: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Squawkabilly
entry: Though these Squawkabilly are the fewest in number, they have no trouble living in towns since they blend in with the white buildings.

name: Squawkabilly
entry: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

name: Squawkabilly
entry: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Squawkabilly
entry: The largest of their flocks can contain more than 50 individuals. They fly around towns and forests, searching for food and making a racket.

name: Squawkabilly
entry: Blue-feathered Squawkabilly view their green-feathered counterparts as rivals, since the latter make up the largest, most powerful groups.

name: Squawkabilly
entry: These Squawkabilly are hotheaded, and their fighting style is vicious. They’ll leap within reach of their foes to engage in close combat.

name: Squawkabilly
entry: The yellow Squawkabilly are especially fierce. They've even been known to drive other bird Pokémon out of town.

name: Squawkabilly
entry: This Pokémon dislikes being alone. It has a strong sense of community and survives by cooperating with allies.

name: Nacli
entry: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

name: Nacli
entry: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Naclstack
entry: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Naclstack
entry: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

name: Garganacl
entry: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

name: Garganacl
entry: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Charcadet
entry: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit . It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Charcadet
entry: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
entry: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Armarouge
entry: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Ceruledge
entry: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon's evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

name: Ceruledge
entry: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Tadbulb
entry: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Tadbulb
entry: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Bellibolt
entry: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.

name: Bellibolt
entry: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Wattrel
entry: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.

name: Wattrel
entry: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Kilowattrel
entry: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Kilowattrel
entry: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Maschiff
entry: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Maschiff
entry: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

name: Mabosstiff
entry: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Mabosstiff
entry: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

name: Shroodle
entry: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Shroodle
entry: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Grafaiai
entry: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Grafaiai
entry: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Bramblin
entry: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Bramblin
entry: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast
entry: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Brambleghast
entry: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Toedscool
entry: Though it looks like Tentacool , Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph .

name: Toedscool
entry: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

name: Toedscruel
entry: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Toedscruel
entry: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

name: Klawf
entry: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents' attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Klawf
entry: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Capsakid
entry: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Capsakid
entry: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Scovillain
entry: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Scovillain
entry: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Rellor
entry: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Rellor
entry: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

name: Rabsca
entry: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Rabsca
entry: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

name: Flittle
entry: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Flittle
entry: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

name: Espathra
entry: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph .

name: Espathra
entry: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

name: Tinkatink
entry: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatink
entry: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkatuff
entry: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkatuff
entry: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp , gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Tinkaton
entry: The hammer tops 220 pounds , yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Tinkaton
entry: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight .

name: Wiglett
