entry: Though it looks like Diglett , Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

name: Wiglett
entry: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
entry: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio .

name: Wugtrio
entry: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Bombirdier
entry: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Bombirdier
entry: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

name: Finizen
entry: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Finizen
entry: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Palafin
entry: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

name: Palafin
entry: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: Palafin
entry: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen 's, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

name: Palafin
entry: This Pokémon’s ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

name: Varoom
entry: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Varoom
entry: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Revavroom
entry: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Revavroom
entry: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Cyclizar
entry: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

name: Cyclizar
entry: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Orthworm
entry: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Orthworm
entry: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

name: Glimmet
entry: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmet
entry: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Glimmora
entry: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Glimmora
entry: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

name: Greavard
entry: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Greavard
entry: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: Houndstone
entry: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Houndstone
entry: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: Flamigo
entry: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Flamigo
entry: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Cetoddle
entry: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetoddle
entry: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer .

name: Cetitan
entry: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Cetitan
entry: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

name: Veluza
entry: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

name: Veluza
entry: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

name: Dondozo
entry: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

name: Dondozo
entry: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

name: Tatsugiri
entry: It's one of the most intelligent dragon Pokémon. It camouflages itself by inflating its throat sac.

name: Tatsugiri
entry: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Tatsugiri
entry: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Tatsugiri
entry: This species' differing colors and patterns are apparently the result of Tatsugiri changing itself to suit the preferences of the prey it lures in.

name: Tatsugiri
entry: This Pokémon tricks its opponents by playing dead. It is small and weak, but it uses its smarts to survive.

name: Tatsugiri
entry: Bird Pokémon are its main prey. This Pokémon knows it's weak, so it hunts with a partner.

name: Annihilape
entry: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Annihilape
entry: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

name: Clodsire
entry: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

name: Clodsire
entry: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: Farigiraf
entry: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

name: Farigiraf
entry: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig ’s.

name: Dudunsparce
entry: A recent study uncovered that the number of segments a Dudunsparce’s body has is determined by the Pokémon’s genes.

name: Dudunsparce
entry: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: Dudunsparce
entry: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Dudunsparce
entry: The gentle Dudunsparce will put Pokémon that wander into its nest onto its back and carry them to the entrance.

name: Kingambit
entry: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Kingambit
entry: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Great Tusk
entry: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Great Tusk
entry: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

name: Scream Tail
entry: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

name: Scream Tail
entry: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

name: Brute Bonnet
entry: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Brute Bonnet
entry: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

name: Flutter Mane
entry: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Flutter Mane
entry: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

name: Slither Wing
entry: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Slither Wing
entry: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

name: Sandy Shocks
entry: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Sandy Shocks
entry: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

name: Iron Treads
entry: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Iron Treads
entry: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

name: Iron Bundle
entry: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Iron Bundle
entry: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

name: Iron Hands
entry: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Hands
entry: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

name: Iron Jugulis
entry: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Iron Jugulis
entry: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

name: Iron Moth
entry: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Iron Moth
entry: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

name: Iron Thorns
entry: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

name: Iron Thorns
entry: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

name: Frigibax
entry: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Frigibax
entry: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

name: Arctibax
entry: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax's strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

name: Arctibax
entry: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Baxcalibur
entry: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Baxcalibur
entry: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

name: Gimmighoul
entry: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

name: Gimmighoul
entry: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Gimmighoul
entry: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Gimmighoul
entry: This Pokémon was born from passion that seeped into a coin. It wanders, apparently seeking to return to the treasure chest it once inhabited.

name: Gholdengo
entry: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Gholdengo
entry: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: Wo-Chien
entry: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Wo-Chien
entry: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

name: Chien-Pao
entry: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

name: Chien-Pao
entry: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

name: Ting-Lu
entry: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Ting-Lu
entry: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

name: Chi-Yu
entry: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Chi-Yu
entry: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit . It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

name: Roaring Moon
entry: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region .

name: Roaring Moon
entry: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

name: Iron Valiant
entry: It's possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Valiant
entry: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Koraidon
entry: It has similar characteristics to a creature described in an old book as the Winged King. *

name: Koraidon
entry: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal . It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Koraidon
entry: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar , but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

name: Koraidon
entry: The ecology and other data about this Pokémon are unknown. It was named Koraidon by the professor who discovered it. *

name: Miraidon
entry: It was given the name Miraidon by the professor who discovered it. Its ecology and other details are unknown. *

name: Miraidon
entry: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar , but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

name: Miraidon
entry: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book . The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Miraidon
entry: Its characteristics match those of a mysterious object recorded in an old expedition journal as the Iron Serpent. *

name: Walking Wake
entry: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune .

name: Walking Wake
entry: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

name: Iron Leaves
entry: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Iron Leaves
entry: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Dipplin
entry: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Dipplin
entry: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

name: Poltchageist
entry: It has taken up residence in a very expensive tea caddy. It takes an expert to distinguish the expensive tea caddies from the cheap ones.

name: Poltchageist
entry: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

name: Poltchageist
entry: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea , but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Poltchageist
entry: It sprinkles some of its powdery body onto food and drains the life-force from those who so much as lick it.

name: Sinistcha
entry: The more stirring it does with the tea whisk on its head, the more energy it builds up. It does this to prepare for battle.

name: Sinistcha
entry: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

name: Sinistcha
entry: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Sinistcha
entry: It lives inside a superb teacup that was crafted by a potter of great renown. Collectors positively adore this Pokémon.

name: Okidogi
entry: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Okidogi
entry: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

name: Munkidori
entry: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Munkidori
entry: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

name: Fezandipiti
entry: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

name: Fezandipiti
entry: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

name: Ogerpon
entry: In this form, it draws on the power of stone. Its body is rock-solid, protecting it from all manner of attacks.

name: Ogerpon
entry: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Ogerpon
entry: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Ogerpon
entry: This form excels in both attack and defense. It ceaselessly unleashes moves like a spring gushes water.

name: Ogerpon
entry: In this form, it draws on the power of water. It attacks unrelentingly with kicks and ivy strikes.

name: Ogerpon
entry: This form is the most aggressive, bombarding enemies with the intensity of flames blazing within a hearth.

name: Ogerpon
entry: In this form, it draws on the power of fire. It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

name: Ogerpon
entry: This form has excellent defenses, absorbing impacts solidly like the cornerstones that support houses.

name: Archaludon
entry: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

name: Archaludon
entry: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

name: Hydrapple
entry: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

name: Hydrapple
entry: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

name: Gouging Fire
entry: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

name: Gouging Fire
entry: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

name: Raging Bolt
entry: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou 's ancestor.

name: Raging Bolt
entry: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

name: Iron Boulder
entry: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Boulder
entry: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.

name: Iron Crown
entry: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Iron Crown
entry: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion .

name: Terapagos
entry: An old expedition journal describes the sight of this Pokémon buried in the depths of the earth as resembling a planet floating in space.

name: Terapagos
entry: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

name: Terapagos
entry: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Terapagos
entry: Upon sensing danger, it prepares itself for battle by creating a sturdy shell of crystallized Terastal energy.

name: Terapagos
entry: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

name: Terapagos
entry: In this form, Terapagos resembles the world as the ancients saw it, and its Terastal energy is abnormally amplified.

name: Pecharunt
entry: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

name: Pecharunt
entry: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
